name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: An update on Ticketmaster
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2186%2E4032634%2EysPFDn

Since I
last sent this note below on why we need to break up Live Nation and
Ticketmaster, we’ve got some new updates. Today, the Department of Justice
officially filed an antitrust lawsuit against Live Nation to break up
their monopoly over the live entertainment industry.

In their announcement, Attorney General Merrick Garland said, “We allege
that Live Nation relies on unlawful, anticompetitive conduct to exercise
its monopolistic control over the live events industry in the United
States at the cost of fans, artists, smaller promoters, and venue
operators. The result is that fans pay more in fees, artists have fewer
opportunities to play concerts, smaller promoters get squeezed out, and
venues have fewer real choices for ticketing services. It is time to break
up Live Nation-Ticketmaster.”

So if you’ve ever spent half a day in the online queue on Ticketmaster
only to have the privilege of paying over $1,000 on a ticket, this one’s
for you.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2216?amount=28&t=1006&akid=2186%2E4032634%2EysPFDn ]I’m fighting hard to continue to take on concentrated corporate power
like this and stop companies from getting away with ridiculously high
prices and ridiculously crummy service. If you agree that we need to break
up big corporate monopolies like this, please pitch in
$28 or
anything you can to support this work.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

--- Forwarded message ---

To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
From: Elizabeth Warren
Date: April 17, 2024
Subject: re: the Ticketmaster lawsuit

Have
you been ripped off by Ticketmaster’s hidden fees and high prices? Have
you spent hours waiting in a queue for tickets that aren’t even available
anymore?? No matter who you’re a fan of — whether it’s Taylor Swift, Bad
Bunny, or Beyoncé, or the Sox or the Celtics — fans are overwhelmingly
united in agreeing that Ticketmaster makes the ticket-buying experience
expensive and excruciating.

So here’s an update you might appreciate: New reporting from the Wall
Street Journal indicates that the Department of Justice plans to file an
antitrust lawsuit against Ticketmaster parent company Live Nation.

This lawsuit will be a big step in the right direction to hold
monopolistic corporations accountable for hurting consumers, and we can
keep making strides if we continue fighting side by side.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ20L_FIN_E_20240523_V1S1&t=1007&akid=2186%2E4032634%2EysPFDn ]I’ll explain more below, but if you agree that we need to break up big
corporate monopolies like this, please add your name here. I’m fighting
hard to take on concentrated corporate power — and when we fight together,
we can stop companies from getting away with ridiculously high prices and
ridiculously crummy service.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ20L_FIN_E_20240523_V1S1&t=1008&akid=2186%2E4032634%2EysPFDn ]ADD YOUR NAME

Just to back up a bit: In 2010, the federal government had let Live
Nation, a huge concert-promoting company, buy Ticketmaster, a huge
concert-ticket-selling company. Together, they became a one-two punch of
market dominance, leaving little competition to rein in skyrocketing
prices and encourage quality service. And their monopoly power goes beyond
just jacking up ticket prices for consumers — it’s harming employees,
vendors, and artists too:

* Ticketmaster has been hiding fees and progressively piling on charges
the further consumers get into the ticket-buying process.
* Live Nation has maintained a gigantic pay gap between CEO compensation
and median pay for employees in 2023 — with CEO Michael Rapino
bringing home $139 million last year, 5,414 times as much as the
$25,673 median pay for employees, according to the Institute of Policy
Studies.
* New findings indicate that Ticketmaster is also using schemes to hide
profits right under our noses — incentivizing vendors to charge them
at higher rates in exchange for undisclosed financial gains in the
form of rebates, which allows Live Nation and Ticketmaster to use
accounting tricks to record a “loss.”
* Meanwhile, they’re making massive financial gains by not disclosing
these rebate arrangements to the artists, managers, or co-promoters,
who are often unknowingly shouldering the costs of these confidential
deals, according to those findings.

Now, harmful corporate consolidation isn’t just in the live entertainment
industry — it’s everywhere. Big agribusinesses are crushing family farmers
and jacking up prices for consumers. Big tech companies are elbowing out
startups and using our private information for profit. Big airlines are
getting away with higher fares for lower-quality service.

Pure and simple, the American people are suffering under the thumb of
corporations that are just too big and too powerful.

I’ll keep calling on the Biden administration to use all of its tools to
fight back against corporate monopolies. I’ve also got a bill — the
Prohibiting Anticompetitive Mergers Act — to ban the biggest, most
competition-crushing mergers, restore competition, and bring down prices
for consumers.

I’ll stay in the fight — but it’s only possible because I’ve got people
like you fighting alongside me.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ20L_FIN_E_20240523_V1S1&t=1009&akid=2186%2E4032634%2EysPFDn ]If you’re with me in this fight, will you add your name to support
holding predatory corporations like Ticketmaster accountable for violating
antitrust laws and ripping off American people?

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-ticketmaster/?source=EMZ20L_FIN_E_20240523_V1S1&t=1010&akid=2186%2E4032634%2EysPFDn ]ADD YOUR NAME

Thanks for being part of this,

Elizabeth

To: Friend
From: Karl Rove
RE: Why I'm so excited about Pennsylvania
* * *

Friend,

Polls in Pennsylvania keep getting better for the GOP. It's true for the Presidential election, but also very true in the Senate race between Democrat Bob Casey and Republican Dave McCormick.

Dave has had a great start to his campaign. We're months away from the general election, but he's doing all the right things to move ahead this fall when it matters most. **Don 't get me wrong, it's going to be a tough fight, but Dave is off and running strong.**

A New York Times poll came out this month showing Dave closing the gap between himself and Casey.

This race is already a toss-up, so here's why I'm encouraged -

* **McCormick has closed the gap with incumbent Casey to just 2 points in the new New York Times poll.**

* **A 17-year incumbent, Casey has total name-recognition. YET _he 's only 2 points up on Dave, making him incredibly vulnerable, as more voters tune in and get to know Dave._**

* **Casey is only at 46% in the TIMES poll and he 's an INCUMBENT! That means not much enthusiasm for him, even though people know him. Any incumbent polling under 50% now is in deep trouble.**

Team –
We have an election coming up on June 25th! Now is the time to make sure that your voter registration is up-to-date and that you’re prepared to have your voice heard.
There are so many important races on the ballot this year, and it is critical that every single eligible voter makes their voice heard.
In Colorado, all registered voters will receive a ballot in the mail. Then, all you have to do is fill it out and send it back! There are also ballot drop boxes located around the state if you’d like to drop off your ballot in person or voting centers if you prefer to vote in person. You can even register to vote, and cast a ballot, all the way up to 7pm on Election Day!
Now is the time to make sure you’re prepared. Check your voter registration and voting address here. [https://www.sos.state.co.us/voter/pages/pub/olvr/findVoterReg.xhtml]
Voters can also vote in-person during early voting or on Election Day! Find a Voting Center or closest Dropbox here. [https://www.sos.state.co.us/pubs/elections/VIP.html]
It’s really that easy to participate in our democracy in Colorado. I’m so proud of the work we’ve done to make voting quick, easy, accessible, and secure.
Happy Voting!
– Jena Griswold

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: cue the sell-outs
body:
FIVE Arizona Republicans just proved they’re not pro-life...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

It’s been weeks, and I’m still FURIOUS.

I’m sure you heard about the **_FIVE_** Republican sell-outs who joined hands with pro-abortion Democrats to keep abortion legal not long ago in Arizona.

These spineless, _Planned Parenthood_ Republicans sentenced countless Arizona babies to death.

**Now, with Arizona’s July 30th Primary Election right around the corner, it’s time that pro-lifers do the same to these politicians’ political careers – just like _Students for Life Action_ is doing all over the country.**

But I’m counting on your support to _MAKE THEM PAY_.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to make your most generous financial contribution today for _Students for Life Action’s_ primary programs](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gpidyd-duchtdja-y/).**

If you ever wanted to know WHY _Students for Life Action_ gets involved in primary efforts, Arizona is a clear-cut example.

If we don’t get involved in primaries, lives will be lost.

**Babies will die.**

It’s that simple.

We just saw it happen!

And as we saw in Arizona, it only takes a handful of pro-abortion Republicans to give the Abortion Lobby everything they want and stab you and me in the back.

In one example that’s all too common, Arizona State Representative Matt Gress campaigned as “pro-life,” but then was tripping over himself to vote with _Planned Parenthood_ and Democrats at the statehouse.

Well, we’re making sure pro-lifers in Arizona _(there are many!)_ know every detail about Rep. Gress’ betrayal.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gpidyd-duchtdja-j/) And with your help, we’re also targeting other Arizona Republicans:

**-** Rep. Justin Carroll Wilmeth - District 2
**-** Rep. Tim Dunn - District 25
**-** Senator Shawnna Bolick - District 2
**-** Senator T.J. Shope - District 16
And that’s in addition to all of our efforts in states like Indiana, Kentucky, West Virginia, Pennsylvania, and elsewhere.

Not only is _Students for Life Action_ focused in Arizona, but also in:

\- West Virginia: Where _Students for Life Action_ exposed how pro-abortion Senate President Craig Blair stopped any amendment from being voted on that would have closed the abortion loopholes in the Mountaineer State. Last week, he was defeated soundly in a Republican Primary!

Also in West Virginia, pro-life champion Sen. Patricia Rucker WON in a tight race after _Students for Life Action_ knocked on 1,224 doors, made 2,751 calls, and sent 3,583 texts!

\- Kentucky: After our door knocking engagement, the GOP leader who co-sponsored a bill to add loopholes for more abortions into the Bluegrass State’s pro-life laws LOST his primary race!

\- Indiana: After one courageous GOP leader refused to go along with Republican party leaders who demanded he help them weaken Indiana's abortion laws, _Students for Life Action_ ensured the Republican establishment didn't defeat him in his primary.

\- South Carolina: Where we will be planning a massive campaign to hold legislators accountable for killing our _Life at Conception Act!_ SIX GOP Senators joined with Democrats to betray their constituents in sentencing preborn babies to death.
The simple fact is, Pro-Life Friend, until pro-lifers teach **_ALL_** Republicans there’s a SEVERE PRICE to pay for crossing us, they’re going to keep doing it.

_Again and again and again_.

That’s why I need your help to _MAKE THEM PAY_!

Not only that, but we need to make sure this madness stops happening by opposing any effort to weaken the Republican Party’s official platform _(as we’re doing with our GOP for Life campaign we just launched)._

**[Will you make your most generous contribution to help _Students for Life Action_ to help keep our election plans going](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gpidyd-duchtdja-i/)?**

**We have a long way to go until November.**

**But what happens will only matter if you and I hold pro-abortion Republicans accountable NOW.**

Whether that’s door knocking until our students' knuckles are bruised, texting until their fingers hurt, or pulling all-nighters trying to get the most work done possible.

And the truth is Pro-Life Friend, we’re winning.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gpidyd-duchtdja-d/) **You can see in the picture here _The New York Times_ even tagged along on our last deployment in Arizona!**

They wouldn’t do that if they weren’t scared of what we’re doing.

With your help, our face-to-face conversations DO make a tremendous difference.

**[That’s why I need you to help me fund current and future canvassing efforts with a donation immediately](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gpidyd-duchtdja-h/)!**

It’s truly a life-or-death situation.

I know I ask a lot of you almost every day, but we can’t waste any more time.

The time is NOW as November is rapidly approaching.

So, please be as generous as you can.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Five bad Arizona Republican legislators just sided with the radical pro-abortion Democrats.

**[Click the link here to help _Students for Life Action_ fight back by educating voters in Arizona and across the nation when self-professed “pro-life” officials betray us, and save babies](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gpidyd-duchtdja-k/).**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: Secretary Mike Pompeo
subject: I’m afraid we have a problem. A big one.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
I briefed President Trump on America’s most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2m2javrfpdo5rs1ptijtnom4vu7gq5ic2igir6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33clgm1ob6c1h2bs "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?
---
| | | [YES: I'LL PITCH IN TEN BUCKS](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdhg7sb7d45akd7lcaud1hdjrvd53cvjqjmsc74g_rp22sh2s8i6ep33clgm1ob6c1h2bs "YES: I’LL PITCH IN TEN BUCKS")

---
| | | [YES: I'LL PITCH IN FIFTY BUCKS](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z095lkh45o67mvsco45gj3l1hqbqqm41qi1jt7kg_rp22sh2s8i6ep33clgm1ob6c1h2bs "YES: I’LL PITCH IN FIFTY BUCKS")
---
| | | [I'LL PITCH IN ANOTHER AMOUNT](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc3qtm48kgkitn9jbdorj8uj899lfi8gdneq74f0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33clgm1ob6c1h2bs "I’LL PITCH IN ANOTHER AMOUNT")
---
I know this is a lofty goal. I know there's not much time to hit it. It would be much easier to call it a day and not even try.

**But just giving up plays right into their hands. **

_**[That's why I'm taking the time to send you this email. Our path to success fully relies on EVERYONE pitching in SOMETHING. That's how we'll catch up to the Democrats and win this election in a landslide.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgtgo7t36bpl4hrptk043oq61napa0ncrr594f4o_rp22sh2s8i6ep33clgm1ob6c1h2bs "That’s why I’m taking the time to send you this email. Our path to success fully relies on EVERYONE pitching in SOMETHING. That’s how we’ll catch up to the Democrats and win this election in a landslide.")**_

Frankly, that's the only way. So I really hope you can step up when we need you the most.

Thank you. God bless you.
Mike Pompeo

## NCAA Approves $2.77 Billion Settlement
The NCAA Division I Board of Directors agreed this week [to a proposed $2.77 billion settlement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu6zAMAL_G3hyIFCklg4a3ZMtbOxqMRCcqZDuw2QT9-yKdOx5uOOA-LuNFaqvL7b_MmmxaR8lWnzrygDQgjdSXNKmi-l4TRAjM_niE_p5iFGHkTJ5YyGnMolkxxIDiJvB9TeiQHCO5IwcIB0_RS1EALjlQgY6clmrrdvhc62J3ndr3-tTtkNe5b-lu9tg7_6_Dc4dneSz62t_qDZvV3LTD85JFhiav_avasKtZ01kXGyIjcJjK1ak4IOKJ8QpXcKcCdELst1Qer9pa3UPsyN1mqe03bH9veCb8CQAA__9TN105) of House vs. NCAA, a class-action lawsuit that seeks to remove limits set on NIL deals and pay damages to former college athletes for denying them potential past earnings. That’s why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. ---
| | Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, **and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.** When you view this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds, you’ll learn timeless lessons that teach:
* The principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

**I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. So, it should come as no surprise to learn that so many "academics" and activists are working to smear Churchill's legacy. That's why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. And right now, you can do just that when you get a copy of one of Hillsdale College's most popular online courses, [**" Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,"**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=da80495a3e024404bfdce1aef760cd7f&_e=n1nljaTCGKexkeW9284-yI5fLvqOSFw1kanZIn09QzFUWsC9-hAlCebu-v_fJAYd8WxjRLoE6Zp6_5u51H8Fi48u8yLKwJi0gWFHsTmDAkRnut4w78Dimv9W4grXSN9xvecG16y8mGkqysk2LT1JYw20TpOrI4VDIhTYht0mZSarrNLtM_42vnbvbj7KI8AruBw-mJwR42iBkNYw4by4ZxJntty_eVkNPmbGtF240ETq4E-OeiqQJ47bKRaN6zKOgsc-zSNjUjLlOvI8wsGcAju5buWJD5mxUUbv661-25qlQeed8Bsmd91MVC9ntVLtT-sVkE-whX8dUKTXOkO9h0augkb6tjBfYlAO9SPjvrcGLoTaaankSakiQLxAtcTsowCHyderQo-BmqZRCxu0pU0KwZGZk9QlzBRSRiGM1qw%3D) on DVD.

| | Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, **and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.** When you view this close study of Churchill's words and deeds, you'll learn timeless lessons that teach:
* The principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

**I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

| | Dear Fellow American, Perhaps no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny than Winston Churchill. Not only did he diagnose the threat of modern technology, but he also spoke most effectively against the idea of socialism. So, it should come as no surprise to learn that so many "academics" and activists are working to smear Churchill's legacy. That's why studying an accurate account of his accomplishments is more important than ever. And right now, you can do just that when you get a copy of one of Hillsdale College's most popular online courses, [**" Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,"**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e34ab062c14e45e8808fe45b708e63ba&_e=7KlXMvGBFKwsFm8LZXVbzDKxyykH7zFlEwwLEUsF9c0zHY-3qcTMfv7aJidk7hbetXl4AY6UTfFHLJ-tVRDVyOmLJP7aVO8STOc_6j-8P6diNmWx083y14kjUAYyMyiXR65d4ZuUcPR1pgTvfqMN6GXuuUGceEsEpwap6BThHBxmpLbz8D_ooo168lW7NBDs5rMePV4Jy23viLrPOtR2xg2_VbARYG6qGa2my1XD-bGUR1suO4W90nOX-gREt0YEu71ADPPVG8_5FA1liP_a7Z9jmmJlgi_KTL4r4QN3byHoJhLMSSQx1T2Blpnr3phLnRglpfejRz62fTemcroqGtaFgWoMKVVEdYN55_TNVW3UCcIcsz5Vvq_Zv7pJzIZAKf5mhOxlqzuTBbmmO1HEQn9fxzh3IxCKueLPCgUSjOA%3D) on DVD.

| | Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, **and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.** When you view this close study of Churchill's words and deeds, you'll learn timeless lessons that teach:
* The principles and virtues required for great statesmanship.
* How to deal with the threats and opportunities presented by modern technology.
* How to confront the threat of socialism.
* How to serve the cause of our own country as it appears today.

**I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set. And it can be yours today when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

I’m a State Representative, small business owner, mother of four, and **the official Democratic nominee running to unseat extreme Republican Rep. Lori Chavez-Deremer in Oregon’s 5th Congressional District.** Democrats need to flip four seats from red-to-blue this November to take back the House – and this is one of them. [**More in a moment, but it’s essential that we start the general election off on the strongest note possible to flip this seat and take back the House. Will you split a donation between Blue Amp Action and my campaign today?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te646cebc-6854-4687-8c92-8191a0b151ac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) The road to this moment wasn’t easy, and there won't be anything simple about defeating Lori Chavez-DeRemer in November. **But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, and to fight for families like yours and mine in Congress.** I learned from my parents that you don’t stop working hard until the hard job is done, especially when it comes to fighting for your community. I'm ready to get to work and win this thing because the stakes of this election are too high not to. Reproductive freedom, voting rights, affordable health care, our democracy itself – it’s all on the line this November. **Simply put: Oregonians can’t afford another two years of Lori Chavez-DeRemer and the extreme MAGA Republican House Majority.** [**Our real fight starts now, Peter. So I'm personally asking: Will you split $25 between me and Blue Amp Action to make sure we have the resources we need to flip this seat, take back the House majority, and get the job done in November?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T00845654-681c-4e4b-82d7-71f67ab51b3f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) From the bottom of my heart, thank you. Friends, We have quite a weekend ahead of us here in Indiana! The Hoosier state is about to light up with two huge events back-to-back, Racers and Pacers! Our own Indiana Pacers are bringing the Eastern Conference Finals back home this weekend. And just down the road, the legendary Indy 500 will be revving into action, where the fastest drivers battle it out for glory. We are lucky to be Hoosier sports fans!

While these sporting events are exciting and create a strong sense of Hoosier pride, let's also take a moment to remember the true meaning of Memorial Day weekend. Amidst the excitement, let's honor and reflect on the brave individuals who made the ultimate sacrifice while serving our country. It's important to pause and pay tribute to those who gave their lives for our freedom.

So as you enjoy the weekend's activities, stay safe, cherish the moments spent with loved ones, and remember the true meaning of this holiday.

Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.

Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# Indiana Leads the Pack in Decreasing Overdose Deaths 📉💊
---
Recently, Indiana received big news regarding the trends in overdose deaths. [Provisional data for 2023 from the CDC shows a nearly 18% decrease in overdose deaths in Indiana, 2nd among all states for that year.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/05ccf867a9ef9a3e3947229f28c3afba/6ae79f3df55e9bdbc3d6b838967d376c/40313) To put that into perspective, overdose deaths in the United States have been an increasing and ongoing problem, especially over the last 4 years. From opioid addiction to fentanyl flowing across our southern border, this has been an issue that Indiana specifically has worked hard to combat. That’s why In 2017 Governor Eric Holcomb signed an executive order dedicating a new cabinet-level position in state government to reversing the trend on overdose deaths in Indiana. Since then Indiana has taken dramatic, thoughtful steps to address this issue. Thanks to the hard work of Republicans in the General Assembly and Governor Eric Holcomb's all-hands-on-deck approach, _**Indiana is leading the charge in reducing overdose deaths**. _ What have Hoosier Republicans done to fix the problem?
* **Indiana 211**
* This service has provided over 32,945 referrals to treatment for mental health and substance use disorder since January of 2020.

* **Regional Recovery Hubs**
* Since 2020, over 186,900 services have been provided by Indiana’s 20 hubs, for Individual peer support, group peer support, and referrals to treatment, housing, and transportation.
**

* **Opioid Treatment Programs**
* Since 2017 11 OTP’s have opened, bringing the statewide total to 24. With an average 14,000 Hoosiers served annually.
**

* **Harm Reduction Street Outreach**
* 10 Harm Reduction Street Outreach (HRSO) teams have distributed 38,800 harm reduction kits since January 2022.
**

* **Justice System Recovery**
* Since July 2021 over 5,100 individuals have completed the Recovery While Incarcerated (RWI) program.
* The Indiana Department of Correction (IDOC) Transitional Healthcare Division has linked over 11,000 released offenders with community-based addiction treatment providers.
* Through a partnership with overdose Lifeline, Inc., Over 24,000 individuals have received a naloxone kit upon release from a DOC facility.
**

From the state to the local level, Republican leaders have worked non-stop to make sure 2023 is just the start of a downward trend in overdose deaths that continues for years. Since President Biden has taken office, lawlessness and an open southern border have led to unsafe neighborhoods and tragic loss of life due to overdoses. Despite challenges created from President Biden's policies, leadership from Indiana Republicans has the Hoosier state headed in the right direction. Where this is still much to do on this front, it is clear that Republican leadership has a plan and is committed to working hard to keep Hoosiers safe.

name: Eva Piatek, Evergreen
subject: Hey PA! Join me and fellow activists for a virtual climate lobby day
disclaimer_text: paid for by Evergreen Action
body:
Make your voice heard on climate action, right from your home
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2573311/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi,

Pennsylvania's clean energy goals have long been out of date. To help Pennsylvania keep up with its peers, Governor Shapiro recently proposed PRESS, a new plan to help position PA to compete in the clean energy economy. With this impactful climate action and other critical proposals pending in the state legislature, it's a critical time to show our elected officials in Harrisburg just how much Pennsylvanians like you and me support effective policies to promote more wind and solar energy, as well as more energy conservation and efficiency.

That's why **we're partnering with PennEnvironment and others on a virtual citizen lobby day for climate action on Thursday, June 6.**

[**Sign up to join Pennsylvania's largest annual citizen lobby day for the environment— and make sure to put "Evergreen" when asked how you heard about this event!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2573312/87SdQ4wZ)

🔵 **What:** Pennsylvania Citizen Climate Lobby Day
🔵 **When:** 30-60 minute time commitment on Thursday, June 6
🔵 **Where:** Online
🔵 **Who:** You and your elected officials, with support from PennEnvironment |
---
[RSVP HERE](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2573313/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| This is a great opportunity to meet directly with your lawmakers and their staff to deliver a clear and compelling message that Pennsylvanians want a clean energy future.

**Did I mention that it's virtual—so you can join right from your kitchen table, living room, or office?**

All you need to do is sign up for a **30-60 minute commitment during the hours of 9 am E.T. and 6 pm E.T.** , and our partners will do the rest: from preparing you with tips and talking points, to scheduling meetings with the elected officials who represent you, **we're making it easy to make your voice heard.**

In a state that too often must defend meaningful climate action from harmful policies, it's never been more important to make sure our lawmakers know that a thriving and just clean energy future matters to their constituents. |
---
[SIGN UP TO JOIN US](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2573314/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| ☝️** _And don't forget_** —make sure to write our name where it says "how did you hear about this event!"

See you there, |
---
| | |
---
### Eva Piatek
Email Production Manager
Evergreen Action

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Intel
subject: Our course on the American Founding—Now on DVD
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsv7StsWNe
Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is
one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osv7StsWNe

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Hello
Friend,

Thomas G.
West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the
great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's
why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core
teachings about the American Founding, which is now available on
DVD.

In this
course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student
and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of
Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr.
West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to
Americans today-even to scholars and teachers of American history
and politics-that the task of uncovering the truth about the
Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and
long-forgotten pit."

This
course goes about this task by examining the actual words and
actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by
comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The
result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the
Founders established a free government in America and what they
thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you
know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the
generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as
many people as possible.

Would you
consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this
course?

And now,
for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful
DVD box set for "The Real American Founding: A Conversation," by
clicking the link below.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63209594:sv7StsWNe:m:3:2532013465:25FDD72ECD5FB336D4C4E0AFDA552667:r

I hope
you'll join us in this fun and important work of sharing the
truth about the American Founding with your fellow Americans.

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

body:
Will you commit to volunteer to make sure we succeed this fall?
| | | |
---
| | | [](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.) | [](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.) | [](https://link.email.chuckmorsefornh.)
---|---|---
| | Derek,
This is an exciting time! Not only are we out-campaigning the competition every day, but we're also leading the way in connecting with voters. Our team, with the invaluable help of grassroots volunteers, has already knocked on thousands of doors and made hundreds of phone calls. This is a movement built on a foundation of community and love for our Granite State.
**However, the fight is far from over, and your help can make all the difference in this election.** ******_Here's how you can help us win --check out the campaign opportunities below!_**
**_If you're interested in any of the following or have questions email: maya@chuckmorsefornh.com_**
---
| | **Share Our Message on Social Media -** The easiest way to help boost our campaign is to make sure you share our social media pages, and be sure to like, comment, and share our posts. We are on X, Facebook, Youtube, and Instagram. By interacting with our posts, you'll help increase our reach to engage more Granite Staters!
---
|
---
**Knock Doors - **Knocking on doors is one of the best ways to share the message of our campain and to get fellow Granite Staters involved. It's also a fun way to meet fellow conservatives from your town/county!
|
---
**Make Calls -** Making calls to voters is another important way to share the message of our campaign, and it can be done from the comfort of your home!
|
---
**Be A Town Captain -** Represent Team Morse in your local area! As a team captain, you'll help distribute signs, attend local GOP meetings, recruit volunteers, and play a vital role in our grassroots efforts.
|
---
**Host A Yard Sign -** Show your support by placing a yard sign on your lawn or at your business. For higher visibility areas, we also offer larger 4x4 signs.
|
---
**Volunteer For Events -** Team Morse will be participating in events and parades across New Hampshire and we need help from volunteers to share our campaign message.
|
---
| | Your support means the world to Chuck and our campaign. Together, we will prove that New Hampshire elections can't be bought--they have to be earned. Thank you for all your efforts so far.
Best regards,
Maya
Campaign Manager

subject: I’m afraid we have a problem. A big one.

body:
I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=47b1e0a72b134372a1fefa1aeb3da3c2&_e=pfx1tsWPaifTp_i5BUue7g3mxDfORLlhUKKpCKaIaEfoAwvtujfwyQR3ljFuCC3FLfOuHoPsMv-LbTygBKDBB0MgzUe6PYKELP3jo182HCkLyLqSIfsUXRO2GZL1ajurf2TGlW4jBz9YzP8JP3N38pLT0nktqFseV3E9zflMgN6OyTSp2WlDoO57ig5z37nEYgvZ08y_VYcYnoze1MhTU5oLIzUxQraZ2rcnEfZTT_ECCER7SDhkP233blY3ZKxJgBkHVmNa7XnUBF2O3In8-5DqAr6-J4OMrck6dVwbRIFw5iR0chN0y5rpSX5riSlKnf_wVrb2MT2J2XnCXUFl7gLBWZZHNx__W5j-ggcNjZXp70vuZJZBWckF6tYXGHr3908DMfq6m726hcHbmEKorQiw2JpNlRgmgAWITAKFWL-nP_t1InROgRprLOdXqAaH4TaF16gQUW8h7Ptu6mlUzw%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. Our aim is to protect the independence of state supreme courts.
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85525182/475075482/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEyOGYxNjMzLWM1MTktZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CeREW6Z0Q4adlaz961ekMyMNcGA2vCDSOofDXEgrR_Q=&emci=6cb1f6a5-2819-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=128f1633-c519-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)

We’re preparing to invest serious resources in state supreme court races in partnership with Planned Parenthood Votes — because _both_ democracy and reproductive rights are being attacked. It’ll take all of us in our grassroots movement to step up and fuel our fight to protect our freedoms, **[starting with small-dollar donations from supporters like you](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85525184/475075491/-1913865780?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_mayfun_email_20240524-NDRC-Red-NDRCPPV_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240524-NDRC-Red-NDRCPPV_&utm_campaign=mayfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjEyOGYxNjMzLWM1MTktZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=CeREW6Z0Q4adlaz961ekMyMNcGA2vCDSOofDXEgrR_Q=)** , but we want you to hear directly from Attorney General Eric Holder why we’re launching our latest partnership: | "The notion that the outcome of a case should be determined by the makeup of a court is antithetical to accepted American jurisprudence.

**"Yet that is exactly what is happening in too many state supreme courts across the country.**

"It is a result of a deleterious, years-long effort by partisan interests to turn state judiciaries into yet another political instrument to force unpopular, minority-supported policies onto the people.

**This anti-democracy campaign must be stopped."**
**– Eric H. Holder, Jr.,** 82nd Attorney General of the United States Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee
---
If we’re going to protect the very fabric of our democracy and reproductive rights, we need to do everything we can to ensure state supreme courts have justices who are dedicated to interpreting the law in a neutral way, who will adhere to precedent, and who will protect the fundamental rights of all citizens.
We know we can make a serious step toward this goal in several elections happening this year, and that’s exactly why we’re partnering with Planned Parenthood Votes.
[**But we can’t win the fight to protect our freedoms without you. # The Story of Kate Cox

Peter- women's rights are non-negotiable.
The ability to control decisions about our own bodies isn't just a matter of policy; it's a fundamental aspect of our humanity.
[**Be sure to watch the video below to learn about Kate Cox's story and understand why women's autonomy is of utmost importance.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=f3ea202799&e=a2a46ff12c)
---
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=418892e46d&e=a2a46ff12c)
| Every person, regardless of gender, deserves the autonomy to access necessary healthcare without fear or interference.
Take the story of Kate Cox, for instance. She had to leave Texas to receive essential care, illustrating the pressing nature of this issue. Countless others like her might find themselves in similar predicaments, forced to choose between their health and the limitations of state laws.
**If elected, I promise to be a voice for women's bodily autonomy.**
I'll fight tirelessly to ensure that every woman's right to make choices about her own body is not only respected but fiercely protected.
I'm ready to champion the rights of women across the United States.
[**Let's rally for a future where every woman can make decisions about her health without hindrance**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=a5b03c762d&e=a2a46ff12c)**.**

This week I spoke at the Naperville City Council meeting on the critical need to divest from the siege on Gaza. Far from unprecedented, I argue--and bring the receipts--that this is a noble act cities have historically taken to disavow war, oppression, and the killing of innocent people. I hope you take a few minutes to watch my remarks below, and take action in your respective city councils as well. I share the text below as a template to adjust to your own personal needs, if you so cohose. It is critical we maintain justice and humanity in all we do, and divesting from a siege that is indiscriminately killing civilians is a critical step forward to ensure that happens.
**Let 's Address This.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..bait30eccy-JAdmI_KaI02c2oCX5sZEItxV6JqVQKxI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144937963)
Watch my three minute long remarks here, [or if you prefer on Instagram](https://substack.com/redirect/14d8a9d6-ebe4-4cd0-aed1-07ab41dc4db2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and read my full comments with references below:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c0cf2740-01cd-4d9b-8468-32c3cb3e8ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Good evening, Mayor, and Naperville City Council.
My name is Qasim Rashid. I'm a human rights lawyer residing here in Naperville with my wife Ayesha and our three children in Naperville public schools.
And I'm here today to ask the Naperville City Council to uphold justice and divest from the horrific siege on Gaza.
**First I want to discuss historical precedent.** Historically, American cities have led the way to divest from injustice and prevent our dollars from harming innocent civilians. When President Reagan and Congress's efforts to fight Apartheid South Africa were grossly insufficient, more than [90 U.S. cities courageously acted to divest billions from South Africa](https://substack.com/redirect/6b793f7b-6175-4f74-9df2-1f6dd0682470?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Archbishop Desmond Tutu applauded these efforts, and a freed Nelson Mandela joined U.S. mayors to continue the fight. That local activity helped generate the thrust for a victory in 1986 with the passage of the Comprehensive Anti-Apartheid Act, a bill so popular by then that it won over the veto of President Reagan. City leaders overpowered even the President of the United States.
That is the wisdom and energy we must take into today, **and thus my second point, current reality.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..bait30eccy-JAdmI_KaI02c2oCX5sZEItxV6JqVQKxI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144937963)
On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine. By December, just 10 months later, [Governor Pritzker signed HB1293 into law](https://substack.com/redirect/c66b3159-ba45-4a9c-9cd7-8399d4bc85d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), effective immediately, divesting Illinois state pension funds from Russian banks and companies. HB1293 was signed specifically in response to the mass civilian casualties in the Ukraine, as a result of Russian bombing.
According to official counts, Russian bombing has killed about 10,500 Ukrainian civilians. A horrific number that almost makes one lose hope in humanity. How horrifying then, that official counts place the number of [Palestinian civilians killed by Israeli bombing at more than 35,000](https://substack.com/redirect/2dc7fd5c-4cea-47ba-a927-ee2fb0266b57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \-- more than triple Ukraine -- with 70% of them being women and children?
It is no wonder that the ICJ has described this as the verge of genocide. The ICC has now officially filed for arrest warrants for Israel's Prime Minister and Defense Minister. And even the US State Department in their report just last week admitted that [Israel is violating international human rights law by killing civilians](https://substack.com/redirect/c0e56884-7c5c-4e9c-974d-508779061119?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Why help fund a government engaging in such atrocity?
**And thus, third and finally, I want to discuss what the future will remember about what we do here today.** (Note, Naperville has financial ties with Boeing, [who is building arms dropped on Gazan civilians](https://substack.com/redirect/1e1ab0e2-80fb-47e9-a0ab-b74b1fc62836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). It is worth noting that the Illinois bill passed to divest from Russia represented less than .005% of Illinois' economy. Any divestment from Naperville will undoubtedly be small compared to the grand scheme. But indeed that is the message--every small act towards justice is critical and that is the message Holocaust scholars give us.
So I close with an excerpt from a letter written by 55 scholars of the Holocaust and Genocide studies, many of whom are themselves Jewish. [They wrote on December 9 of last year making 7 demands](https://substack.com/redirect/f3a40eb3-9566-42c9-879a-cb2b62fa7816?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), of which I only have time to read the first and the last for the purposes of our discussion today. They write, first:
> The time for concerted action to prevent genocide is now. We call on governments to uphold their legal obligations under the UN Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide by implementing an arms embargo on Israel.
And they write, finally:
> We also call on businesses and labor unions to ensure that they do not aid and abet Israeli mass violence.
They write that such acts will ensure safety and security for Jews and Palestinians alike, will guarantee the equality, freedom, dignity, and security of all the people "who live between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea."
May the future attest that we here in Naperville, under righteous leadership, heeded this call for justice, and stood on the right side of history. Thank you.

Far from unprecedented, I argue--and bring the receipts--that this is a noble act cities have historically taken to disavow war, oppression, and the killing of innocent people. I hope you take a few minutes to watch my remarks below, and take action in your respective city councils as well. I share the text below as a template to adjust to your own personal needs, if you so cohose. It is critical we maintain justice and humanity in all we do, and divesting from a siege that is indiscriminately killing civilians is a critical step forward to ensure that happens. Let 's Address This. Watch my three minute long remarks here, , and read my full comments with references below: Good evening, Mayor, and Naperville City Council. My name is Qasim Rashid. I'm a human rights lawyer residing here in Naperville with my wife Ayesha and our three children in Naperville public schools. And I'm here today to ask the Naperville City Council to uphold justice and divest from the horrific siege on Gaza. First I want to discuss historical precedent. Historically, American cities have led the way to divest from injustice and prevent our dollars from harming innocent civilians. When President Reagan and Congress's efforts to fight Apartheid South Africa were grossly insufficient, more than . Archbishop Desmond Tutu applauded these efforts, and a freed Nelson Mandela joined U.S. mayors to continue the fight. That local activity helped generate the thrust for a victory in 1986 with the passage of the Comprehensive Anti-Apartheid Act, a bill so popular by then that it won over the veto of President Reagan. City leaders overpowered even the President of the United States. That is the wisdom and energy we must take into today, and thus my second point, current reality. On 24 February 2022, Russia invaded Ukraine. By December, just 10 months later, , effective immediately, divesting Illinois state pension funds from Russian banks and companies. HB1293 was signed specifically in response to the mass civilian casualties in the Ukraine, as a result of Russian bombing. According to official counts, Russian bombing has killed about 10,500 Ukrainian civilians. A horrific number that almost makes one lose hope in humanity. How horrifying then, that official counts place the number of \-- more than triple Ukraine -- with 70% of them being women and children? It is no wonder that the ICJ has described this as the verge of genocide. The ICC has now officially filed for arrest warrants for Israel's Prime Minister and Defense Minister. And even the US State Department in their report just last week admitted that . Why help fund a government engaging in such atrocity? And thus, third and finally, I want to discuss what the future will remember about what we do here today. (Note, Naperville has financial ties with Boeing, ). It is worth noting that the Illinois bill passed to divest from Russia represented less than .005% of Illinois' economy. Any divestment from Naperville will undoubtedly be small compared to the grand scheme. But indeed that is the message--every small act towards justice is critical and that is the message Holocaust scholars give us. So I close with an excerpt from a letter written by 55 scholars of the Holocaust and Genocide studies, many of whom are themselves Jewish. , of which I only have time to read the first and the last for the purposes of our discussion today. They write, first: The time for concerted action to prevent genocide is now. We call on governments to uphold their legal obligations under the UN Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide by implementing an arms embargo on Israel. And they write, finally: We also call on businesses and labor unions to ensure that they do not aid and abet Israeli mass violence. They write that such acts will ensure safety and security for Jews and Palestinians alike, will guarantee the equality, freedom, dignity, and security of all the people "who live between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea." May the future attest that we here in Naperville, under righteous leadership, heeded this call for justice, and stood on the right side of history. Thank you. subject: Remembering Uvalde

body:
It’s been two years since 19 children and two teachers lost their lives to gun violence in Uvalde, Texas.
| | |
---
Friend,
It’s been two years since 19 children and two teachers lost their lives to gun violence in Uvalde, Texas.
My heart goes out to the community still grieving and the families and friends whose lives will never be the same. While I can’t imagine the loss they’re carrying, I do know what it’s like to lose someone to gun violence. It’s a terrible pain that I've carried with me since I was 24, and one that I expect will stay with me forever.
It's knowing this type of loss that pushed me into public service. And now, being a mom is what continues that drive to advocate for gun violence prevention. It is terrifying to send your kid to school and not know if they'll come back home. But it's the staggering reality we live in today.
**Right now, firearms are the number one cause of death of children in the United States. It’s the greatest moral failing of our time. Parents, kids, teachers, everyone deserves to feel safe in their own community. In order to do that, we have to take action to address gun violence.**
While we’ve made progress in passing comprehensive gun violence prevention legislation, I know we still have a long way to go. I’m running to expand gun safety laws and end gun violence, so no child has to live in fear.
So much damage has already been done. But I hope my promise to continue this fight helps others know that together, we can change the future and make our communities safe for our loved ones.
Thank you,
Debbie

name: ARI
subject: ARI AI Policy Impact Forum Recap
body:
A group of bipartisan lawmakers joined ARI President Brad Carson to discuss the path forward on AI policy. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/97420e20a7cf/invitation-522-ai-policy-impact-forum-12682636?e=a07d75591f)
---
|
# Recap of ARI’s AI Policy Impact Forum on Capitol Hill
---
| _U.S. Senators Todd Young (R-IN), Joni Ernst (R-IA), and U.S. House Members Ted Lieu (D-CA), Jim Himes (D-CT), and Don Beyer (D-VA) joined ARI President Brad Carson to discuss the path forward on AI policy._
---
| _ARI President Brad Carson (left) moderates a panel discussion with U.S. House Members [from left] Jim Himes (D-CT), Ted Lieu (D-CA), and Don Beyer (D-VA)._
---
| In case you missed it — bipartisan lawmakers from the House and Senate gathered on Capitol Hill on Wednesday May 22 at an artificial intelligence policy event to discuss some of the most pressing challenges surrounding the technology facing Congress and the federal government. The AI Policy Impact Forum, convened by Americans for Responsible Innovation (ARI), was held at the U.S. Capitol Visitor Center and featured U.S. Senators Todd Young (R-IN) and Joni Ernst (R-IA), as well as U.S. House Members Ted Lieu (D-CA), Jim Himes (D-CT), and Don Beyer (D-VA).
“We’re incredibly grateful to the Members and Senators who joined us on the Hill to have serious discussions about the approach Washington is taking to AI. It was important for us to hear from the lawmakers who are really leading on this issue and who are considering AI policy in a thoughtful and forward-looking way,” said ARI President Brad Carson. “This was our first opportunity to bring lawmakers together for an open conversation on the wide variety of policy issues concerning AI, and to demonstrate our approach to helping our elected officials think about and develop a governance framework for AI that balances competing priorities, from addressing current harms, to protecting from emerging risks and promoting innovation. We think the Forum was a big success in that regard.”
During the event, Members and Senators from across the aisle went into detail on a wide range of AI policy issues, discussing everything from competition with China, to data privacy concerns, to small business impacts, demonstrating how far-reaching the technology’s impact has become in Washington.
---
| Senator Young, part of the Bipartisan Senate AI Working Group that recently unveiled its AI policy roadmap, explained, “This is a pivotal moment to get right in our history. I think the AI Roadmap has contributed to the conversation around establishing global standards and investing more in our own efforts in the U.S., and now it is time for the committees of jurisdiction over various aspects of AI policy in the Senate to take the baton laid out by the plan and run with it.”
---
| _From left: ARI President Brad Carson and U.S. House Members Jim Himes (D-CT), Ted Lieu (D-CA), and Don Beyer (D-VA)._
---
| During a roundtable discussion moderated by Carson, House AI Task Force Co-Chair Lieu, addressing global competition on AI, stated, “Western countries and companies are at the frontier of developing large language models, which are really the leap forward with AI technology. Our adversaries can eventually catch up, but it won’t take 20 years like with our Air Force and jet fighter capabilities, for example.”
In addressing federal priorities for AI policy, House Intelligence Committee Ranking Member Himes stated, “In terms of regulating AI, if we really wanted to take a constructive step, we would pass a federal data privacy bill. If we can’t determine who owns what data under what circumstances, then how do you regulate a technology that is fundamentally developed and driven by data? If we have to put something at the top of the list, let’s start there.”
Alongside his colleagues, Rep. Beyer addressed next steps for the House Task Force and the White House Executive Order on AI, stating, “I’m immensely proud of the Executive Order, which is the largest in history and has allowed America to drive forward on AI. I’m hopeful that, as a Member of the House Task Force on AI, we will look at what pieces of the Executive Order can be affirmed through legislation in Congress.”
---
| Closing out the event in a discussion with Carson, Senator Ernst encouraged the audience to “know that the United States Congress is engaging on a wide variety of AI issues. For example, as the Ranking Member on the Small Business Committee, we have a number of avenues to engage with AI, including through the Small Business Innovation Research Program and the Small Business Technology Transfer Program. Developing guardrails as outlined in the AI roadmap is the right thing to do, but we need to do so in a way that doesn’t hinder the opportunities of the future.”
ARI will continue to pursue discussions on AI policy with lawmakers, thought leaders, and other stakeholders in the run-up to the election. The organization recently [lauded](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=cf0e8653d7&e=a07d75591f) the rollout of the Bipartisan Senate AI Working Group roadmap, and [co-led](https://responsibleinnovation.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=2c0afb73cc&e=a07d75591f) a joint letter signed by over 90 organizations, companies, and universities to support NIST funding for AI-related work earlier this year.
---

subject: Uvalde, TX was changed forever two years ago
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
On May 24, 2022, the community of Uvalde, Texas was changed forever when a shooter opened fire at Robb Elementary School, taking the lives of 19 students and two teachers. Now, 21 families will never be whole again. Nineteen fourth graders will never have the chance to grow up and those who survived will face a lifetime of recovery. We must never forget the innocent victims whose lives and futures were stolen from them.
Last fall, I had the opportunity to visit Uvalde and meet with many of the families. It was an emotional day as we honored the victims and survivors of this unspeakable tragedy.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240524-1-30&t=1&akid=8161%2E3935704%2Eb9AThu)
Unfortunately, Texas is all too familiar with the horrors of gun violence. Since Governor Greg Abbott took office, gun deaths have increased more than 60 percent. This is unacceptable, and it’s why we just launched GIFFORDS Texas. With this new initiative, we will take on the gun lobby and work with local advocates and policymakers to reverse the state’s worsening gun violence epidemic.
GIFFORDS Texas will engage communities across the state who have been impacted by gun violence, including Latinos, survivors, gun owners, and youth. The program will also dedicate resources towards a robust multi-year advocacy plan to shape common sense gun safety policy that better reflects the priorities of Texans.
With our continued efforts, I truly believe we can make our country a safer place. We can be a nation where children and teachers don’t fear for their lives when they go to school. I won’t rest until that future becomes a reality. Please, keep standing with me in this important fight.
Sincerely,
Gabby Giffords

Now, 21 families will never be whole again. Nineteen fourth graders will never have the chance to grow up and those who survived will face a lifetime of recovery. We must never forget the innocent victims whose lives and futures were stolen from them. Last fall, I had the opportunity to visit Uvalde and meet with many of the families. It was an emotional day as we honored the victims and survivors of this unspeakable tragedy. Unfortunately, Texas is all too familiar with the horrors of gun violence. Since Governor Greg Abbott took office, gun deaths have increased more than 60 percent. This is unacceptable, and it’s why we just launched GIFFORDS Texas. With this new initiative, we will take on the gun lobby and work with local advocates and policymakers to reverse the state’s worsening gun violence epidemic. GIFFORDS Texas will engage communities across the state who have been impacted by gun violence, including Latinos, survivors, gun owners, and youth. The program will also dedicate resources towards a robust multi-year advocacy plan to shape common sense gun safety policy that better reflects the priorities of Texans. With our continued efforts, I truly believe we can make our country a safer place. We can be a nation where children and teachers don’t fear for their lives when they go to school. I won’t rest until that future becomes a reality. Please, keep standing with me in this important fight. Sincerely, Gabby Giffords GIFFORDS PAC works to reduce gun violence and save lives by empowering voters with information and supporting candidates who will fight for safer gun laws. Please, consider making a contribution today to help fuel this lifesaving work. ** Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org

| | I wanted to catch you before you went away for the holiday, and respect the sacred meaning of Memorial Day by honoring those that have paid the ultimate sacrifice for our great nation. So you're getting another update today! We are __**11**__ __** DAYS**__ away from the June 4th Primary Election, and even though it's only been four days since the last update, we have gotten so much done. I also wanted to check in again on your plan to vote. You can learn more about the three voting options below, and make a plan to cast your ballot for Tom Kean, Jr. & the Republican Team ✅ This week, our field team was once again busy launching volunteers, hosting phone banks, and __**making yard signs**__! We had another great week of voter contacts through our phone calls made by volunteers, and will be out this weekend knocking doors. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to!
---
| | **Field Update**
---

---
| | This past week, and heading into the weekend, our field teams covered doors in _**Raritan Township**_ , _**The Town of Clinton**_ , _**Readington**_ , _**Westfield**_ , _**Peapack-Gladstone, Branchburg**_ , _**Mendham Borough,**__**Flemington**_ , and _**Alexandria**_. Our Field Team are excited about the upcoming GOTV weekend and expanding our ground game across all six counties before the primary. Kean for Congress once held our weekly phone banks in _**Somerset**_ , _**Hunterdon**_ , and _**Morris**_ counties. We spoke with voters across all six counties who still had outstanding vote-by-mail ballots, as well as encouraging non-VBM voters to vote in-person either early or on Election Day. The energy and conversations with these voters were fantastic, and it is clear that Republicans are ready to win up and down the ticket and **_send Tom Kean back to Congress in November_**! Friend, I am asking for your help. Next week is critically important for our team. We want to speak with as many Republican voters as we can before Primary Day. The Kean for Congress team will have a significant Get out the Vote (GoTV) effort and we need all hands on deck. We are seeking volunteers to assist with door knocking and phone banking to GoTV! clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | I wanted to catch you before you went away for the holiday, and respect the sacred meaning of Memorial Day by honoring those that have paid the ultimate sacrifice for our great nation. So you're getting another update today! We are 11 DAYS away from the June 4th Primary Election, and even though it's only been four days since the last update, we have gotten so much done. I also wanted to check in again on your plan to vote. You can learn more about the three voting options below, and make a plan to cast your ballot for Tom Kean, Jr. & the Republican Team ✅ This week, our field team was once again busy launching volunteers, hosting phone banks, and making yard signs! We had another great week of voter contacts through our phone calls made by volunteers, and will be out this weekend knocking doors. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | Field Update | | | | This past week, and heading into the weekend, our field teams covered doors in Raritan Township , The Town of Clinton , Readington , Westfield , Peapack-Gladstone, Branchburg , Mendham Borough,Flemington , and Alexandria. Our Field Team are excited about the upcoming GOTV weekend and expanding our ground game across all six counties before the primary. Kean for Congress once held our weekly phone banks in Somerset , Hunterdon , and Morris counties. We spoke with voters across all six counties who still had outstanding vote-by-mail ballots, as well as encouraging non-VBM voters to vote in-person either early or on Election Day. The energy and conversations with these voters were fantastic, and it is clear that Republicans are ready to win up and down the ticket and send Tom Kean back to Congress in November! Friend, I am asking for your help. Next week is critically important for our team. We want to speak with as many Republican voters as we can before Primary Day. The Kean for Congress team will have a significant Get out the Vote (GoTV) effort and we need all hands on deck. We are seeking volunteers to assist with door knocking and phone banking to GoTV! We have door knocking shifts beginning Thursday 5/30 to Monday 6/3 and phone banking shifts from Tuesday 5/28 to Monday 6/3. Can we count on you? Want to join us? Use the button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | Lawn Signs Are In! | | | | | | Volunteer of the Week:Antje Doyle | | | | Antje Doyle is our Kean for Congress Volunteer of the Week! Antje was born and raised in Germany, and now serves the Clinton Township community through volunteerism and activism. She serves as the Municipal Chair of Clinton Township GOP, as well as on the Hunterdon County Republican Executive Committee. Her late husband, William Doyle, was the beloved former Sheriff of Hunterdon County. The Doyle family has served the state and NJ07 with the fullest of hearts. Antje joined the Kean for Congress team both days last weekend to door knock and will be out again this weekend! Please thank Antje for all her hard work - we are lucky to have her on the Kean for Congress team. | | | | | Tom In The News | | | | | | | Voting Resources and Upcoming Dates Vote-by-Mail ballot deadlines are quickly approaching. |
---

I appreciate all of the kind words and messages following the election in April. I have been taking some time to evaluate my next steps but I am reaching out today to ask a favor of my supporters.
Yesterday, my dear friends, Former AZ GOP Chairwoman Dr. Kelli Ward and her husband Dr. Mike Ward, pleaded not guilty to Conspiracy, Forgery, and Fraud charges brought by corrupt Arizona Prosecutors.
These bogus charges being leveled against them in Arizona are just another example of the lawfare that is being waged against Republicans across the country.
The Democrats and their corrupt judicial system are bankrupting some of our greatest fighters for freedom and the America First movement, and we must stand with them in this fight.
Kelli and Mike have become dear friends over the past four years, and it breaks my heart to see what they have to endure just for supporting our 45th president.
I am writing you today with a call to action; I am asking everyone who receives this email to donate just $1 to their Legal fund. If everyone donated just a dollar to the cause, we would raise more than $50,000 dollars to help with their legal expenses as they stand up for our freedom.

subject: Here’s the situation
body:
The fight to defeat SB4 continues! | | | Peter, here’s the situation on SB4: **First:** Texas lawmakers and Governor Greg Abbott passed an unconstitutional, discriminatory law allowing Texas police to arrest, jail, and deport migrants even **_suspected_** of crossing the border. **Then:** The Biden administration sued to block the law from going into effect. The case made its way to the Supreme Court, where it was allowed to go into effect for just a few hours until being paused again by a federal court. **Now:** Another decision is expected to come any day that could again allow SB4 to take effect in Texas while litigation plays out. We don’t know what the decision will be, but it’s critical that we start preparing. This law is certain to open up Black and brown people and immigrants to racial profiling, discrimination, harassment, and danger. **We must continue to fight back to strike down SB4!** Other states are watching this decision closely. Florida, Arizona, and Kansas are following Governor Abbott’s lead and trying to set up their own deportation machines. If the courts allow SB4 to go into effect, we’ll see similar laws all around the country. We **MUST** fight back now. **This is an all-hands-on-deck moment.** We need the support of this grassroots team to help fuel our fight for immigrant justice and ensure our communities in Texas know their rights. clean_body: The fight to defeat SB4 continues! | | | Peter, here’s the situation on SB4: First: Texas lawmakers and Governor Greg Abbott passed an unconstitutional, discriminatory law allowing Texas police to arrest, jail, and deport migrants even suspected of crossing the border. Then: The Biden administration sued to block the law from going into effect. The case made its way to the Supreme Court, where it was allowed to go into effect for just a few hours until being paused again by a federal court. Now: Another decision is expected to come any day that could again allow SB4 to take effect in Texas while litigation plays out. We don’t know what the decision will be, but it’s critical that we start preparing. This law is certain to open up Black and brown people and immigrants to racial profiling, discrimination, harassment, and danger. We must continue to fight back to strike down SB4! Other states are watching this decision closely. Florida, Arizona, and Kansas are following Governor Abbott’s lead and trying to set up their own deportation machines. If the courts allow SB4 to go into effect, we’ll see similar laws all around the country. We MUST fight back now. This is an all-hands-on-deck moment. We need the support of this grassroots team to help fuel our fight for immigrant justice and ensure our communities in Texas know their rights. We won’t stop fighting for a future where all are welcomed and free to live safely. | Dear Peter -
I know you must be disillusioned with politics these days, especially the kind of politics displayed in Congress.
The incentive structure for Members of Congress has been polluted in such a way that making law, crafting serious policy, and having informed, in-depth debates about the pressing challenges facing America are not priorities for our country's leaders. Instead, Congress is full of people more interested in performance and outrage, cable news hits and social media stardom.
What's worse is that these actions are followed by shallow, incessant fundraising appeals. You are bombarded with texts and emails for "10X matches" and "exclusive membership programs" that demand you send your hard-earned money to politicians in order for them to "fight for you" and "save our country." I know that must be tiring.
That is why I try to offer something different.
I hope you find my messages informative and thoughtful, because that is what I am aiming for every time I communicate with you. That's what you deserve.
You deserve to know exactly how I am going to use your donations when you generously contribute to my campaign. I use your donations to help elect serious, conservative leaders up and down the ballot across America - to sustain and grow our majority in the House and help advance conservative policies at every level of American politics. I use your donations to grow our conservative movement, with policy and political summits that attract new and younger Americans into our party. I use your donations to win the messaging battle against the far-left on the biggest debates facing the country: combating illegal immigration, protecting American energy security, and restoring strong American leadership on the world stage.
Your donations also ensure I am able to stay in Congress. The contributions from committed patriots like you across the country fuel my campaign. While many quality Members of Congress have decided to retire or resign, and that can be discouraging, I view it as all the more reason to stay in the fight.
I have been proud of the work I've been able to accomplish since taking office. I serve on the powerful Energy and Commerce Committee, where I'm fighting to protect American energy independence and advance commonsense solutions to our country's healthcare challenges. I serve on the Intelligence Committee, where I'm addressing the serious national security threats facing America. And I serve as Chairman of the Cartel Task Force, where I'm developing solutions to destroy the Mexican drug cartels who are facilitating the border crisis and killing tens of thousands of Americans with fentanyl. Every term that I've been in Congress, I've passed conservative policies into law - on energy policy, on national security policy, and policies to get veterans suffering from PTSD the help they need.
All of this would be impossible without your help. I'm asking you for a donation today so that I can continue this good work for you. You can donate at this link:

* Our nation has made incredible strides toward freedom and equality for LGBTQ+ people.
* Extremists have recently stepped up their attacks on our rights in a way that is ugly and dangerous.

Here in Kansas, our Legislature passed a bill to prevent transgender kids from accessing the health care they need. That was just a few weeks after the Kansas GOP released a platform that condemns same-sex marriage. Derek, after
years of reading the news about Donald Trump, very few things surprise me.

So I can’t say I was surprised when I read this headline:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=may2024_abs_em.HG8rlH&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240524_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6498%2E5257348%2E4XZ2SV ]What Trump promised oil CEOs as he asked them to steer $1 billion to
his campaign

The long and short of it is that Trump told some oil company CEOs to give
his campaign $1 billion, and in exchange, he’ll cut the companies’ taxes,
undo environmental regulations, and prevent new climate policies from
passing during his second presidential administration.

Derek, there is
no line Trump isn’t willing to cross to get back in power.

Before becoming president, he loved to boast about “the art of the deal”
(though we now know how poorly some of those deals actually worked out for
him).

He worked with the Russian government to sabotage Hillary Clinton’s
campaign in 2016 and then tried to bully Ukrainian President Volodymyr
Zelenskyy into helping him cheat in the next election.

Now, as he courts far-right mega-donors for a second term, Trump is making
deals with wealthy CEOs of oil companies. His quid pro quo style of
running a campaign is dangerous and wrong. It should be — and probably is
— unlawful as well. The fact he’s making these corrupt bargains with the
fossil fuel executives who are destroying our climate makes it even worse.

I’m running for Senate to make sure Trump is held to account for these
deals. Because if he makes it back to the White House, the people he will
be serving will not be the American people — it will be Russian dictators,
CEOs of oil companies, and members of the Trump family.

We need to protect our environment. Pass a Green New Deal, build a
stronger, greener economy, and safeguard our planet for future
generations.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=may2024_abs_em.WQbX9u&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240524_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=6498%2E5257348%2E4XZ2SV ]If you support this work, please chip in a few dollars to my campaign
so I can fight for our planet from the U.S. Senate and work to hold Trump
to account for his shady dealings. Thank you in advance for anything you
can give.
