Hi team,
Today marks two years since the devastating school shooting at Robb Elementary in Uvalde, Texas. With 21 murdered and 17 injured, it is the _**deadliest school shooting to ever take place in a Texas public school**_.
Thousands came together to demand reform and slammed Greg Abbott and Ted Cruz’s lack of action and accountability.
So where are we now?
In 2024, there have already been 10 school shootings in Texas, and **_141_ school shootings in the US so far.**
Texas lawmakers have continued to oppose legislation that could have prevented this massacre and others like it. They’re against background checks, and they adamantly oppose raising the minimum age to purchase a _semi-automatic weapon_.
So who holds _them_ accountable? Simply put, we do.
We can’t let another Uvalde, Pulse, or Aurora happen ever again. No matter where the story takes place, the solution is always the same: **We need gun reform NOW**. Too many lives have been lost, and nothing has changed.
[Right now, I need you to stand with us and urge your state legislators to pass new and improved gun safety laws. We can’t wait for the next mass shooting to demand action. Casten has made his position known - loud and clear.

As votes have come to the House Floor, Casten has repeatedly voted in favor of Illegals over American Citizens!

Who is he representing? Certainly not the people of District 6!

body:
Help students like me hear the truth... | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.redconservatives.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_s=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_t=n9-eq5-K2mNV4AU2YaYXn2idSGEeRmtauuPUJ38bvSXUeQEQ6qcAutSGXzUhbGUyO0RG5QgiMJkF2MF6-Q5Z_xscooJMX4c52-vWk6N6Dz8%3D)_
---
[](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_e=wdzutLpG52w-OWTtTbqUSu_ZBhSo6IQZYOpJn9vjo9y_Ei3sqjy34ZPF0i19vQmEH4ULJit0jrMqXYynuA1aG8kD4RrEaMvra8P7SemL9d_FIWbQwaqAbyJClM3ox6mVR-iMOxbvkq9E5vcN_LoB1nIreneeAdmWycRkWWHOncpNZ7_Pkm4EplUUBDHDfATAxl_BtJOVBxab8Y_24DxkMwdJjEZhMAci4wkMezsMcG42yQM2T9iJ4GyPaxhyDc0zazOID0tV_wiW1RAegjM51VB2VZr0C_N-2Dasp4FKDspeNe4qYXFLNMFbXCrgY_uZkZkIul2Ap2MO1V_-mjarjNKXIGgpvJyHQN7Q2x5mWOAKczAOdzGzFbH43_NrrGQc)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_e=wdzutLpG52w-OWTtTbqUSu_ZBhSo6IQZYOpJn9vjo9y_Ei3sqjy34ZPF0i19vQmEH4ULJit0jrMqXYynuA1aG8kD4RrEaMvra8P7SemL9d_FIWbQwaqAbyJClM3ox6mVR-iMOxbvkq9E5vcN_LoB1nIreneeAdmWycRkWWHOncpNZ7_Pkm4EplUUBDHDfATAxl_BtJOVBxab8Y_24DxkM_cp3lDyeVP0Idqwqjlh-WKeS-G9izhg5pTJkXGpszkmZ9cip8MmgovyLNO3TilFfT0_ZVHu9U2CXOHhpHQkJIKkeQ2rZcKZ76JzhOhaDOUPRDFCzvs-O55HEw3twSvOfXOO3_OhubrFpsluh3EGggn_O6_yIOQ54alGUsp67EQB)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_e=wdzutLpG52w-OWTtTbqUSu_ZBhSo6IQZYOpJn9vjo9y_Ei3sqjy34ZPF0i19vQmEH4ULJit0jrMqXYynuA1aG8kD4RrEaMvra8P7SemL9d_FIWbQwaqAbyJClM3ox6mVR-iMOxbvkq9E5vcN_LoB1nIreneeAdmWycRkWWHOncpNZ7_Pkm4EplUUBDHDfATAxl_BtJOVBxab8Y_24DxkMznm2_HzQ4-BgZdfUnEBjtFSf3CO82aKdktZJNoF7bo8A_al0HSGKaMliC5Rbh7bxz_RBCHwcf-URW3fuFYeFsdGsYIUKQz3LtHr1uY6uEj0INkIi5Dn1D2gCQIFUJa2aF-l2vShr0-x4IxNp58SZZJlAkfWNG-x19utbAAI_I8T) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_e=wdzutLpG52w-OWTtTbqUSu_ZBhSo6IQZYOpJn9vjo9y_Ei3sqjy34ZPF0i19vQmEH4ULJit0jrMqXYynuA1aG8kD4RrEaMvra8P7SemL9d_FIWbQwaqAbyJClM3ox6mVR-iMOxbvkq9E5vcN_LoB1nIreneeAdmWycRkWWHOncpNZ7_Pkm4EplUUBDHDfATAxl_BtJOVBxab8Y_24DxkM5HDBRvWuOTD0ZqqTaOmnPpmU6iGA-VjRaDrknLV7zG-AwoWliok6SLLXyrsyQu0dPlgeUPNvUyYoIONc64bkm5QVFbEra-DUA2qnqOKd6Lpops-v8DNNXCkCvNzX7EcXPD3NBuqNik2-VOVCKTIAztM0LKM5nizumIwcDNk1yPw)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**
* * *

---
_**Young America 's Foundation**
11480 Commerce Park Drive Suite 600
Reston, VA 20191-1556

800.USA.1776_ [Unsubscribe from messages sponsored by Young America's Foundation.](http://links.redconservatives.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_s=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_t=n9-eq5-K2mNV4AU2YaYXn2idSGEeRmtauuPUJ38bvSXUeQEQ6qcAutSGXzUhbGUyO0RG5QgiMJkF2MF6-Q5Z__a_YRZCIlKg6j4hLJuvGoLTJ6FwyJ9cPu8aGqTgostWxyZdtd5prQaSX10RPdlAFVzfz9h7TykJfhv3T_pizYI%3D)

[Unsubscribe from all communications](http://links.redconservatives.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_s=559b408e3e5941a2a9e793a30b0760e7&_t=n9-eq5-K2mNV4AU2YaYXn2idSGEeRmtauuPUJ38bvSXUeQEQ6qcAutSGXzUhbGUyO0RG5QgiMJkF2MF6-Q5Z_xscooJMX4c52-vWk6N6Dz8%3D).

subject: Tell Lawmakers to Reject Loopholes for Hydrogen Subsidies
body:
Signature Goal: 5,000 LCV members. Add your name >>? Tell Lawmakers: Reject Loopholes for Hydrogen Subsidies
Corporate polluters are fighting to create loopholes that would direct clean hydrogen subsidies ? meant to fight climate change ? to fossil fuel companies and carbon-emitting power plants. If they get their way, these subsidies could even increase greenhouse gas emissions.

As the Biden-Harris administration finalizes eligibility for clean hydrogen programs, we need environmentalists like you to make it clear to lawmakers that fossil fuel and utility lobbyists should not be writing these important policies.

We need 5,000 LCV members to make their voices heard. Add your name right now >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/- TAKE ACTION NOW https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/bxyvTqK_ ? ?
? Peter ? the Biden-Harris administration is about to finalize subsidy eligibility for clean hydrogen, a new technology that will help reduce emissions in industries like steel manufacturing and long-haul shipping that are difficult to decarbonize.

Here?s the problem: fossil fuel and utility lobbyists are fighting to stretch subsidy eligibility to cover dirty energy industries, too. Their proposed loopholes could even increase climate-harming emissions, while effectively turning programs designed to fight climate change into yet another dirty energy subsidy for Big Polluters. And the last thing we need is more of our tax dollars going to dirty energy.

We need your help to make sure that environmentalists? voices are heard. Sign our petition to help us reach 5,000 signatures demanding that clean energy subsidies do not benefit Big Polluters Oil or increase greenhouse gas emissions >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f_2P_xf_

In December, the Biden-Harris administration proposed guardrails that would help ensure that subsidies cover only truly clean hydrogen, produced with renewables-based electricity?and decreasing emissions, as Congress intended.

Since then, fossil fuel and utility lobbyists have been working hard to pressure members of Congress and the Biden-Harris administration to weaken their proposal. Eliminating safeguards, or creating big loopholes for special interests, would undermine our climate goals and raise energy costs for working families, putting our communities and planet at risk.

Tell your members of Congress to support, and the Biden-Harris administration to finalize, strong rules for clean hydrogen to protect our climate, not give away money to dirty energy. There?s still time to weigh-in ? please help us reach our 5,000 signature goal right now >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ambdFragr~

Thank you for taking action, Peter.

I'm reaching out to you today because we are facing a critical moment to protect the health and well-being of millions of Americans.
Let me know, 👍 or 👎, agree or disagree? No one should be forced to open a Go-Fund-Me account to pay for a medical bill.
drbob.me/aboutbob [drbob.me/aboutbob]
[^and everyone else, too.]
If you support our plan to cover all Americans with universal healthcare, I have a June 1 fundraising deadline, and I'm 79% to our goal. Your generosity goes a long way in our crucial fight.
DONATE TODAY [drbob.me/aboutbob]
Friend ,
The need for Medicare for All is not just a policy; it's a matter of life and death. This crucial initiative has the potential to save over 68,000 lives and a staggering $450 billion annually. We cannot afford to wait any longer.
Regrettably, my opponents on the right are advocating for proposals that would raise the Medicare eligibility age. Their short-sighted plans may save money in the short term but will cost thousands of lives.
We cannot let it happen.
We need leaders who prioritize the health and well-being of their constituents.
I have dedicated my career to serving the community as a family doctor, public health medical director, educator, social worker, and diplomat. Everyone should have healthcare. No co-pays. No deductibles. No administrative fees. Just quality, comprehensive healthcare:

subject: Cleaning the Wall with the 3 remaining Vietnam veterans in the U.S. House
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WITH HONOR ACTION, INC
body:
| | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/820814b52759/invitation-two-parties-two-veterans-one-conversation-rep-lalota-rep-ryan-special-session-with-president-carter-alumni-13540145?e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| | | |
---
| | | | Colleagues,

With Honor Action continued our annual tradition of cleaning a memorial on the National Mall with the bipartisan veterans in the For Country Caucus. 15 Members of Congress, including the three remaining Vietnam veterans in the U.S. House, joined us. We visited the future site of the GWOT Memorial on the Mall after the cleaning.

Please view and share this video with others, which is linked on X [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=f13d3a0f82&e=33f53a5b1a).
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=4601356d67&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| For those of you in DC, please join us this Memorial Day at 5:00 PM at the future site of the GWOT Memorial for a playing of Taps and a moment of silence for our sacred war dead and their families. The site is located at the intersection of Constitution Ave and 23rd St.

For an additional reflection on Memorial Day and the work of the bipartisan veterans With Honor Action supports in Congress, please watch [this recording](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=71de6e5216&e=33f53a5b1a) of a SALT panel I moderated with Navy veteran and For Country Caucus Vice President, Rep Mikie Sherrill, and Army veteran, Appropriations cardinal, and Member of the For Country Caucus, Rep Steve Womack, who was the recipient of With Honor’s 2023 Principles Before Politics Award.
---
| Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Rye Barcott
CEO & Co-Founder
With Honor Action
---
| | | |
---
| Please visit With Honor's new website at [www.withhonor.org](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=4b858bd652&e=33f53a5b1a) and consider forwarding this to a friend who may be interested in learning -- and doing -- more for our country.

# Upholding the Truth
### We must be committed to Truth
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/redirect/c872fbcb-ca1e-460e-af33-0a4738d2c58c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| May 24
---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c872fbcb-ca1e-460e-af33-0a4738d2c58c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Dear Friend,
Where opinions often overshadow facts and noise can drown out reason, it is more important than ever to stand firm in our commitment to the truth. From my perspective, this means not only recognizing the importance of truth but also having the courage to speak it boldly.
Truth is not merely a matter of personal belief or convenience; it is a fundamental principle that underpins our society and informs our values. As conservatives, we understand that maintaining this principle is essential for the health and stability of our community. We believe in the enduring wisdom of our traditions and the lessons of history, which have taught us that truth is non-negotiable.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/38b274be-31d0-48cc-aeb6-f3f02f0b1573?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
It is easy to shy away from difficult conversations or to soften our stance to avoid controversy. Doing so would betray the very values we hold dear. We must remain steadfast, speaking the truth even when it is unpopular or challenging. This is not an act of defiance, but one of integrity and responsibility.
While it is important to be respectful and considerate in our discourse, we must not allow these virtues to dilute our commitment to truth. Our role is to lead by example, demonstrating that it is possible to engage in meaningful dialogue without compromising our principles.
In these times, let us reaffirm our dedication to speaking the truth boldly and clearly. By doing so, we honor our heritage, protect our future, and contribute to a society grounded in reality and reason.
Sincerely,
Dan Carr

| | I've talked a lot the last two years since _Roe_ was overturned about the consequences that ruling would have for women and doctors nationwide. Since that day in 2022, we've read headline after headline about how women are being denied the care they need. But today I'm writing to tell you about another case currently before the Supreme Court that, if allowed to be upheld, would protect an Idaho state law that says that no doctor can perform an abortion in an emergency room **even if the woman's life is at risk**. Yes, you read that correctly: the state of Idaho is suing to let women die in emergency rooms instead of giving them the life-saving reproductive health care they need. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85552641/475159176/-2044921950?refcode=2024-05-24-id&recurring=&amount=7&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=029d9ee4-ea19-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjlkOWVlNC1lYTE5LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lfAQ1NIiz2O-XrmpxpzKpF6kbBH5c-udgAf7biTji6Y=) **A****lawyer representing Idaho during oral arguments even conceded that**** _organ failure_****would not in and of itself qualify someone for an abortion.** This also means that if a doctor decides to intervene and provide abortion care to save a woman's life, that doctor could face persecution for doing so, and that means women are going to die. This seven-figure ad buy comes on top of reports that Republicans are spending more on Ohio than any other race in the country – all because they know it could decide Senate control.
There's no sugar-coating this, Peter: I'm facing the toughest race of my life against a self-funding, Trump-endorsed opponent, record-breaking spending from national Republicans, and now a massive smear campaign on the airwaves.
**If we don't fight back ASAP, it could cost us this race and our Democratic Senate majority. That's why we just set a $100,000 rapid-response goal, and I'm personally asking for your grassroots support to get there. **
**[Will you rush $5, $7.50, or anything at all to split between my campaign and Bob Casey to help me fight back against GOP attacks, win in Ohio, and keep the Senate blue?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240524-2?refcode=em20240524-2&refcode2=3053_552475_XOsA46&akid=3053%2E552475%2EXOsA46)**

| | | Peter -

Early voting locations open this Saturday, May 25th, and you can find your closest voting location [HERE!](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=d7377774b3&e=fc26432468)

If you need help figuring out who to vote for in those confusing independent judicial races, check out [Nevada Republican Club Action's list of recommended judicial candidates](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ed04842ddc&e=fc26432468).

As we make this final push towards the primary, **we are seeking volunteers for a variety of roles, from phone banking to greeting Republicans at early voting locations! **

Our volunteers play a vital role in helping us connect with voters. We are polling ahead of the competition, and that's all because of our hard work at the grassroots level. I take pride in creating a community among our supporters and I work every day to make every voter know they're important. _While others in this race try to buy this election_ , **we're earning votes by building connections and we need your help to do it!**

If you've been thinking about getting more involved, _now is the perfect time_. Your commitment can make a real difference in these final weeks leading up to June 11th. Please [contact my campaign manager Linnea](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=Volunteer) for more information.

Your support has been a blessing throughout this campaign. Now is the time to work together to finish strong! 💪

# **_Endorsement Alert!_**
"Liberty Watch is proud to endorse proven freedom fighter and conservative champion Drew Johnson in Nevada's 3rd congressional district. Drew Johnson isn’t just the best choice, he’s the only choice if Republicans want to win this crucial U.S. House seat in November."

This [Liberty Watch endorsement article](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=9bc35a74d7&e=fc26432468) does a great job of contrasting Drew with his two closest challengers in the GOP primary. It's a must-read if you're undecided about who to vote for in the CD3 primary.
---
|
---
| Drew is so grateful for Victor Joecks' incredible endorsement in the [Las Vegas Review-Journal.](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=ea767425c5&e=fc26432468)

"Nevada Republicans’ best flip possibility is in the 3rd Congressional District. Democrats’ voter registration lead is under 5 percentage points. Republicans would be wise to go with Drew Johnson. He’s extremely smart and articulate. He’s the former president of a free-market think tank. He famously exposed that climate alarmist Al Gore’s home used 20 times more power than the national average. Johnson almost beat Clark County Commissioner Justin Jones two years ago, so he’s electable. Self-funding may allow Dan Schwartz or Marty O’Donnell to spend more, but neither has the record Johnson does."

# _**On the Campaign Trail**_
Farhan and Ellie Naqvi hosted an incredible fundraiser for Drew at their home last week. Dozens of business owners and entrepreneurs **came together to support Drew and make it one of the most successful political fundraisers in Nevada this cycle!**

Drew is extremely grateful to have the support of the Naqvis! Their generosity and passion has improved our community and their hard work is an inspiration for many here in Las Vegas.

| A HUGE thank you to our wonderful friend and supporter, Rose, for opening up her home and hosting a wonderful event for Drew. Drew is thankful for the overwhelming support he has received in Nevada Trails. Drew's signs are all over the community!

The turnout was awesome and the food was delicious! During the event, Drew was formally endorsed by four of Nevada's leading veterans organizations, including the [Armed Forces Chamber](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=85a143598c&e=fc26432468) and [Veterans In Politics International](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=74ad20148e&e=fc26432468).

# **_Get a Yard Sign for your Home! _**
---
| Show your support for Drew by putting a yard sign in the front of your home!

**One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign** is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign within 30 days of the June 11 primary election. **That means you can put them up NOW!**

**We'll deliver your FREE sign right to your door!**

Email your name and address to [info@DrewforNevada](mailto:info@DrewforNevada?subject=YARD%20SIGN!) and we'll ship one at **NO COST** to you!

You can help our campaign with this small, but vitally important show of support!

# _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 3_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

1. **Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=867e3fbeb7&e=fc26432468)**.

2. **Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew** : Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email [linnea@drewfornevada.com](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!).

3. **Volunteer for the Campaign:** #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Peter,

Mifepristone, a key drug used in medication abortion, was approved by the FDA in 2000 and has since been used by _millions_ to safely terminate pregnancy and treat miscarriage. In fact, last year it was used in _more than half_ of all abortions in the United States.
Its safety has never been called into question until April of 2023 when an anti-choice organization in Texas filed a baseless lawsuit and a Trump-appointed federal judge ordered the FDA to reverse its approval.__

**Make no mistake, Peter, this is _exactly_ what Republicans were hoping would happen when _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned.** Without _Roe's_ precedent, anti-choice extremists have worked overtime to attack and threaten millions of Americans' access to abortion on every front.

Despite the overwhelming body of research affirming mifepristone's safety, we can expect these kinds of attacks in our post-_Roe_ landscape. What Republicans can't deny is that the overwhelming majority of Americans are pro-choice and deserve to have access to safe and reliable reproductive care.

[](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=347d146a99&e=ad9732c88c)
| Hi Peter,
✅ It’s official: I’m on the ballot in Kansas.
[**Deciding to run for Congress for KS-03 was not a decision I made lightly. I’m not a politician... and I’ve never run for office before.**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=1ae5ffee45&e=ad9732c88c)
I am a concerned citizen who was frustrated with the state of our nation... and decided to do something to fix it. After all, I own an HVAC company, so I know a thing or two about fixing dysfunctional systems.
So I got to work studying the issues, talking to civic and business leaders, attending **over 1,000** community meetings, and going through extensive trainings that prepared me not only to win... but also to serve effectively.
[**Hard work, dedication, and perseverance are three things I value and apply to my daily life.**](https://kcforkansas.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=212126f9ae4ee4dd7828dd81f&id=c8ac5a602b&e=ad9732c88c)

body:
| I will never forget where I came from.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=2676%2E35263%2EfGLcJq)
Peter — Do you recognize the little girl in this photo? [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-may24.HLGTSS&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240524_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=2676%2E35263%2EfGLcJq) Yep, that’s me from when I was younger. Growing up, I was diagnosed with a serious illness that kept me in the hospital for three months. When I recovered, my grandparents who raised me searched for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future in case I got sick again. But they couldn’t find such a policy. Not from _any_ insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket and make enormous sacrifices to do so — **all because I had a pre-existing condition.** That’s why I got into public service. I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. I thought no one should ever have to go through that. Unfortunately, my story isn't a unique one. It's an experience shared by 133 million Americans living with pre-existing conditions. Before the _Affordable Care Act_ was passed, people with pre-existing conditions could be denied coverage. So you can imagine my frustration when Republicans are attacking our health care and threatening the coverage for people with pre-existing conditions. If my opponent and Republicans take back the Senate, they could undo the progress we've made by repealing the ACA and bringing us back to a place where insurance companies once again write all the rules. I’ve fought against Republicans’ years-long efforts to repeal the ACA before, and I won’t stand down in the fight to protect access to affordable health care. **But I can't do it alone, Peter. I need your help to keep up this fight in the U.S. Senate.** **[Will you make a donation to my reelection campaign so I can keep up this fight? With your help, we’ll prevent Republicans from rolling back the progress we've made for millions of Americans like me who have a pre-existing condition.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-may24.HLGTSS&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240524_AM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=2676%2E35263%2EfGLcJq)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $5 NOW](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/3663?c0=tbe-em-may24.viyL1N&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240524_AM1_V1_S1&t=6&akid=2676%2E35263%2EfGLcJq)

The race went to a recount, and ultimately, after all the ballots were counted, I came just 546 votes short of defeating Boebert. _Ours was the closest race in the entire country._
We did it all with zero support from national Democrats while also being outspent by Boebert’s campaign and her allies.
How? By driving 24,000 miles in my red pickup truck to every corner of the district, showing up, meeting people where they were, and _listening_ to everyone. We put in the work, and people like you who volunteered, donated, made phone calls, etc... You made it all possible.
With Boebert now having running off scared, things are going to be harder and get even nastier. The Super PACs are going to try to smear me on every TV across the district.
**We can fight back against their lies and win this critical House seat, but I’m counting on your support now to do it. clean_body: Friend, When I ran for governor, I knew that we could only do big things if we worked together in partnership toward shared goals. I learned first-hand that you can’t ask for a better partner in the work than President Joe Biden. In partnership with the Biden Administration, we’ve created momentum for more opportunities here in Maryland. We have the lowest unemployment rate in the entire country, and we are beginning to systematically address the racial wealth gap. We’ve created nearly 40,000 new jobs right here in Maryland and that wouldn’t be possible without President Biden. President Biden is rolling up his sleeves to fight for the American people. He faces a critical election this year, and when I think about the stakes of this election, I think about one word: Freedom. President Biden is working to expand our freedom for women to make their own health care decisions, for us to live in safe communities, and for us to have economic mobility. He is a fighter, a friend, and someone who has our backs. I’m hoping you’ll join me in supporting his re-election campaign efforts. = | = Elevate, Wes

Their newest scheme: to hire moles that will gather “on-the-ground intel to inform” on Jill - _and_ try to find ways to keep her off the ballot.

name: Joe Biden
subject: Counting on you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Biden for President
body:
You've stood with me time after time, and your generosity isn't taken lightly. I really mean that. | | |
---
Listen, folks: This campaign isn’t about me. _And it never will be._ This campaign is about _all of us._ It’s about OUR future together. That’s why I feel so fortunate to be out on the campaign trail meeting supporters like you all across the country. I’ve met some really incredible people over the past year, and I wanted to share those experiences with you. In North Carolina, I sat down with Eric and his sons, Christian and Carter. Over burgers and fries, I got to hear all about Eric’s path to becoming a teacher and Carter and Christian’s basketball teams and extracurriculars. Eric shared with me how student loan relief has changed all of their lives for the better. It meant so much to me to hear that. For years now, the right-wing media empire has been responsible for the shuttering of local newsrooms nationwide.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85560533/475182213/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE5YjEwNzktZjcxOS1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kcvVbyb9Z96geWd2Uw6lZX0v2ISdOLn9nddVcd5O-Bk=&emci=aa663471-3b19-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=419b1079-f719-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Earlier this year, _The Baltimore Sun_ — the largest daily newspaper in Maryland — was purchased by the Sinclair Broadcast Group, the right-wing media empire that’s been taking over local media outlets for the last decade.
In case you don’t know, _The Baltimore Sun_ is one of the highest-quality newspapers in the country. In 2020, they won the Pulitzer Prize for local reporting.
Despite this fact, Sinclair’s ownership of _The Sun_ is off to a disturbing start:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85560534/475182214/-593472309?refcode=20240524-EM-SunSinclair&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE5YjEwNzktZjcxOS1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kcvVbyb9Z96geWd2Uw6lZX0v2ISdOLn9nddVcd5O-Bk=)
As local newsrooms close or get gobbled up by the right-wing Sinclair, more and more communities are being left without reliable local news coverage, leaving “news deserts” where communities are susceptible to right-wing disinformation.
[**At COURIER, we’re fighting back by building the largest left-leaning network of local newsrooms in the country. We call ourselves Democracy’s newsroom – can you chip in today to power our work?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85560535/475182215/-593472309?refcode=20240524-EM-SunSinclair&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE5YjEwNzktZjcxOS1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kcvVbyb9Z96geWd2Uw6lZX0v2ISdOLn9nddVcd5O-Bk=)
Just last year, Sinclair made news by ceasing most or all local news broadcasts at 10 of its stations in different cities and states across the country.
As multiple news teams were laid off, they were replaced by Sinclair’s national weekday program, _The National Desk_ — **which has a lengthy history of platforming right-wing misinformation. **
Unsurprisingly, _The National Desk_ is no substitute for real local news. The program devotes the overwhelming majority of its programming to national news stories and has aired and repeated right-wing misinformation and conspiracy theories on everything from the January 6th insurrection to immigration and much more.
But that’s not all, Peter. Sinclair has even used the program to propagate antisemitic stereotypes and conspiracy theories.
_**Needless to say, none of this is good for our democracy. **_
With one of the most consequential elections in our lifetime approaching, the need for accessible, factual news to cut through right-wing BS has never been more critical.
And it’s become increasingly clear that the mainstream media aren’t up for the task.
That’s why COURIER was founded to be the antidote to right-wing misinformation. Our mission of providing local, factual news restores trust in journalism, a key institution of any healthy democracy.
But if we’re going to remain at the forefront of exposing dangerous propaganda from right-wing media empires like the Sinclair Broadcast Group, it’s essential that our newsrooms have the resources they need to continue providing their communities with high-quality journalism.
[**So, can you pitch in $10 today to support COURIER’s honest journalism?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85560537/475182217/-593472309?refcode=20240524-EM-SunSinclair&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDE5YjEwNzktZjcxOS1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kcvVbyb9Z96geWd2Uw6lZX0v2ISdOLn9nddVcd5O-Bk=)

This week, two progressive organizations – the National Democratic Redistricting Committee and Planned Parenthood Votes – announced _huge_ investments in digital ads and get-out-the-vote operations for Ohio’s upcoming Supreme Court elections.

Before we ask you to [**chip in to our Judicial Fund to help us flip the Republican-controlled Ohio Supreme Court,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85561116/475183467/2031547105?refcode=odp_em_240524_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OWFmYTFiZi1mNzE5LWVmMTEtODZkMC02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fdQyo623DqAkZMbH5-eYLQ7W83e4pi6ZpIEvrZmQ3SM=) we want to talk more about what these investments mean.

First, **just because these groups are investing in Ohio’s Supreme Court elections, doesn’t mean that we let up. The more money they funnel into Ohio to help us flip the Court from red to blue, the harder Republicans will try to match it.**

Secondly, it’s not surprising these groups are investing in Ohio _because last November proved our state is winnable_. For too long, Ohioans have had to endure a Supreme Court that puts politics over people. And with the Court expected to rule on MAJOR issues – including how Issue 1 is implemented (plus a slew of other abortion access arguments), partisan gerrymandering, voter suppression, and more – we simply can’t afford to have justices on the Court who don't honor the rule of law.

**Not to mention we’re the only state in the entire country with the chance to flip our Supreme Court.****** They know as well as we do that this is a big opportunity.

So while we’re thankful we’re receiving this national attention, we want to remind you that the battle is only just beginning and our work is far from over.

| Peter, as Democrats are working to lower costs and broaden health care access, Trump and extremists are making moves to destroy Medicare and Social Security programs.

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

From MAGA Mike Johnson himself to Matt Gaetz, Lauren Boebert, and seemingly every GOP VP candidate, national Republicans have been flocking to New York to support defendant Donald Trump in the first-ever criminal trial of a former president.
Instead of denouncing Trump’s lawlessness and standing up for the rule of law, Republicans are making it abundantly clear that no matter what Donald Trump does, they will never criticize the disgraced former president. He simply can do no wrong in their eyes.
In fact, House Republicans were so busy coordinating their public display of support for Trump on Thursday that they delayed their own baseless contempt hearing of Attorney General Merrick Garland, which they had previously insisted was urgent business for the Oversight Committee to address.
**This latest stunt exemplifies House Republicans’ philosophy: abdicate your congressional duties in favor of appeasing Trump.**
Instead of staying in Congress, rolling up their sleeves, and getting to work for the American people, they’re shirking their responsibilities to undermine the rule of law and our democracy by interfering in an ongoing criminal prosecution.
The rule of law must be allowed to play itself out, Peter — but Republicans are willfully and blatantly using their official power to stand in the way.

body:
John Lee insults veterans |
---
| | Dear Peter,

As the proud wife of David Flippo and an American who has witnessed true sacrifice and dedication. My husband, David, has devoted over two decades of his life to serving our great country in the United States Air Force, leading more than a thousand men into combat. Those years weren’t easy for our family; the kids and I often faced days, sometimes weeks, not knowing where David was when he was deployed in the Middle East.

I was shaken to my core when I [**heard John Lee’s comments about David**](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=da0102ad14&e=273c9a71fb). To hear another person call my husband a “nobody,” to reduce his sacrifice and leadership to merely [“taking orders,”](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=1df43cab47&e=273c9a71fb) and to claim he “hasn’t done anything for the community” with “no value there” is not only untrue, it’s deeply disrespectful. These remarks are an insult not only to David but to all who have worn our country’s uniform and their families who have supported them.

David is far from a “nobody.” He is a hero to our family and to his country. Beyond his military service, David has been a pillar in our community, always leading with integrity and a deep commitment to improving the lives around him. His actions have always spoken louder than words, from working with local women’s clinics, to helping the homeless in the tunnels of Las Vegas, to volunteering with veteran’s groups and serving as a financial advisor to those in need.

It's disheartening and frankly disgusting that someone who aspires to public office would stoop so low as to diminish the genuine contributions of a veteran. This isn't just about David—it's about respecting each individual who has served and continues to serve our nation.

**[Today, I am also proud to announce that David has received the official endorsement of the Nevada Veterans Association](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=43855af870&e=273c9a71fb),** a testament to his unwavering commitment and service to our veterans' community. This endorsement strengthens our resolve to ensure that our district is represented by someone who truly understands the meaning of service and sacrifice. [](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=40081c5dcc&e=273c9a71fb) I am asking you to stand with us. Stand with a true leader who values service, community, and country. We need your support to counter these attacks and spread the truth about the man I know, love, and deeply respect. [Can we count on you to join us in this fight?](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=093038fe55&e=273c9a71fb)

Please consider contributing to our campaign or volunteering your time. Together, we can ensure that our district is represented by someone who truly understands the meaning of service and sacrifice.

Thank you for your [continued support](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=a75b585d58&e=273c9a71fb) and for standing with a real hero.
---
| | With all my gratitude,
---
| Dawn Flippo

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38872%2E3422442%2ESnVNNf)
Derek,
I’m proud to share with you that I just introduced a landmark piece of legislation: The Presidential Ethics Reform Act.
No matter which party is in power, the American people deserve transparency from the President and Vice President. **This bill requires these leaders and their families to disclose their tax returns, large gifts, and other conflicts of interest.**
By requiring these disclosures, we can shine a light on any improper conduct in the executive branch — or be confident none occurred. That will help restore the American people’s trust in our government and democracy.
I’m still focused on the future of our country because I’ve seen how desperately we need to enact real change. On the campaign trail, I heard from so many Californians who distrust the government and are losing faith in our democracy’s ability to deliver for them.
Truth to Power is endorsing and supporting candidates who will carry the torch and continue to fight for ethics, transparency, and honesty from our elected leaders. **[Will you make a $5 contribution today to help Truth to Power get these candidates elected?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240524?refcode=em20240524-38872&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38872_3422442_SnVNNf&akid=38872%2E3422442%2ESnVNNf)**
Thank you,
Katie Porter

I received a death threat from Beijing because I love Liberty, Freedom, and the United States of America. More on that in a minute.

Right now, I want to introduce myself.

_My name is Lily Tang Williams, and I fled Communist China and escaped the evil Communist indoctrination. I'm running for Congress because I fear the country I love is becoming like the country I left._

You see: I was born to illiterate working-class parents in China's western Sichuan province just before Mao's Cultural Revolution. I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism.

At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends.

Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self–evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America.

_**I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America.**_

In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995.

Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio.

I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok.

_And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress._

The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda.

But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights.

**[Please, will you stand with me and make a special donation of $25, $50, or $100 to stand with me?](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f1209441d1c34e1ab7bec265208d7d72&_e=Sde7w4wn-QGdNEXXrlACuhjSD04F4G9WKX3VDjMT951eb2SKt1UEcPCFi0tlm5hthu861U9IwzNfHWsvI0HQTRU3hI_ggcMfBnOzzjji1dPeV1ZUrkiUiJtn0sOXS8lxRaZmN7meccbC6VIbIq_X6y3p3481P1LD9bD-rq2hSOpPae-eZ97BtyMxnjzTnrV2XW5uQt4H83ps-6HJroNxoI0X9vDLIUlJJIouDK_RQo4waFlQFiTqCXMC4epsg5zb-Qn8hbq8v1tTWmCzPhrAO2A-qGDnvyUuCdMRM4-dpQ_CJn9LNHnfqETQNV-9OfG-0-2_6kbIzJ5DkZMvTQkKWu1aWcUxQlB_ihRqmJeifm9WW-kklgvfEkZK_2pHQREF6z6GVUeodCNcJrTvGsdnVw4G0l1L1rYXlShnZrlCt_A%3D)**

_Believe me. I'm not fear-mongering when I say you cannot imagine the horrors of Socialism and Communism. It is evil._

**[That's why I need you to stand with me and preserve the freedoms and values of our American heritage.](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=f1209441d1c34e1ab7bec265208d7d72&_e=Sde7w4wn-QGdNEXXrlACuhjSD04F4G9WKX3VDjMT951eb2SKt1UEcPCFi0tlm5hthu861U9IwzNfHWsvI0HQTRU3hI_ggcMfBnOzzjji1dPeV1ZUrkiUiJtn0sOXS8lxRaZmN7meccbC6VIbIq_X6y3p3481P1LD9bD-rq2hSOpPae-eZ97BtyMxnjzTnrV2XW5uQt4H83ps-6HJroNxoI0X9vDLIUlJJIouDK_RQo4waFlQFiTqCXMC4epsg5zb-Qn8hbq8v1tTWmCzPhrAOxuKdDPy1OafyT8fVsxx8NbGexiVtf9Nxfsc_45DoDHVsU4_CE3R2spRdEYhGVdSOsmTu879Ret02paur135WAzZQMtJ52KDgpQ_zeGlZIzzABekm84wpW0rPj2WotskUR0gPoRiVLlGR5l9nb-_ZDo%3D)**

Lily Tang Williams

I grew up in extremely poor living conditions with food rationing, social chaos, and indoctrination into Communism. At a young age, I learned a hard lesson about surviving in a Communist regime: conform and keep your thoughts private. Do not trust anyone, even your friends. Everything changed when an American exchange student showed me a pocket-sized version of "The Declaration of Independence." Even with my limited English skills, I could understand most of these words: "We hold these truths to be self–evident...." It's like a lightbulb came on. I had never heard such beautiful words before, and I loved them so much that I spent many hours with my American friend to learn more about these new concepts and America. I had a new dream: I wanted to go to America. In 1988, I made it to America with only $100 in my pocket, which I borrowed, along with a $1,200 loan from my sponsor. I spoke very little English. In the 33 years since I have enjoyed living in this great country. I received a graduate degree, got married, raised three children, started my own business, and was naturalized as a U.S. citizen in 1995. Fast forward to today: I've spoken out against Communism and Socialism appearing on Fox News, Tucker Carlson Tonight, Fox Business, Newsmax, Timcast, Huckabee TV, John Stossel, Joe Pags Show, Gothix TV, Shawn Ryan Show, Epoch Times TV, and Glenn Beck Radio. I've authored opinion articles for The Epoch Times, Town Hall, National Review, Union Leader, Concord Monitor, and Granite Grok. And here's where the death threats from Beijing started: when I decided to run for Congress. The Democrats don't want my story to reach the ears of my fellow Americans because they hope to enact their Socialist Agenda. But more importantly, you and I cannot afford to let the woke liberal elite plunge the America we know and love any further down the dark path of Communism and trample on our God-given rights. Believe me. I'm not fear-mongering when I say you cannot imagine the horrors of Socialism and Communism. It is evil. For freedom, Lily Tang Williams | I fear that the country I love is becoming like the country I left. That's why I am running for Congress. |

### We must be New
Peter -- We must build a new kind of political party and we must rely on new people getting involved in politics. Our convention will be a great place to experience what this can be. We've invited guest speakers from advocacy groups for electoral reform issues, experienced activists, and candidates. We have planned trainings on all the skills we're developing to create success and addresses from our statewide candidates Eric Settle and Chris Foster. There are no better people to spend the day with than Forward supporters. Are you interested in making real change to the way things are done but can't stand the negativity and hopelessness of today's politics? Do you dream of a better political environment without all the nastiness and partisan games, and do these dreams get dismissed as naive or impractical? Us too. "3rd party's never work", "they're just spoilers", "politics will never change, pick a side". If you hear these things, we want you. We're not going to try to force you into a political box, we want people to express their own views, and help them see themselves reflected in their government. If that sounds like a naive utopian vision by a group that doesn't know how things really work, I'm sorry we must be new, because it sounds perfectly reasonable to us. **Where:** Gettysburg Hilton Garden Inn
1061 York Road

clean_body: A new party for people new to politics | We must be New Peter -- We must build a new kind of political party and we must rely on new people getting involved in politics. Our convention will be a great place to experience what this can be. We've invited guest speakers from advocacy groups for electoral reform issues, experienced activists, and candidates. We have planned trainings on all the skills we're developing to create success and addresses from our statewide candidates Eric Settle and Chris Foster. There are no better people to spend the day with than Forward supporters. Are you interested in making real change to the way things are done but can't stand the negativity and hopelessness of today's politics? Do you dream of a better political environment without all the nastiness and partisan games, and do these dreams get dismissed as naive or impractical? Us too. "3rd party's never work", "they're just spoilers", "politics will never change, pick a side". If you hear these things, we want you. We're not going to try to force you into a political box, we want people to express their own views, and help them see themselves reflected in their government. If that sounds like a naive utopian vision by a group that doesn't know how things really work, I'm sorry we must be new, because it sounds perfectly reasonable to us. Where: Gettysburg Hilton Garden Inn 1061 York Road Gettysburg, PA 17325 When: June 1st, 2024 - 10am - 6pm | "2024 Convention tickets" There will be more info coming. If you think this is the right time for what the Forward Party is doing, this is the right time to join us. defeating Trump, saving Social Security, and defending our Democracy hinge on this

# The Frederick Douglass Celebration
A Great American, A Great Republican
---
| **Frederick Douglass Alive****by Don Pesci**
---
[Subscribe to Don' Pescis Substack ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=fc1676b75c&e=8763c56857)
| Frederick Douglass has much to teach us about what slavery and prejudice is, how to combat both and, most importantly, how to secure our human liberty. A critic once slammed G. K. Chesterton’s view of the world as upside down. Chesterton responded that the world of his day was upside down and, to view it properly, one must stand on one’s head. Douglas stood on his feet and saw within reach a vision of the world that was his constant companion.Douglas’ letter to Thomas Auld, once his slave master, rights an upside down world. Douglass published his letter in North Star, an abolitionist newspaper he had founded in 1847.
Even at six years old, Douglass, then a slave, was perplexed when he had asked himself why he was a slave. Sometime later, “I heard some of the old slaves talking of their parents having been stolen from Africa by white men, and were sold here as slaves. The whole mystery was solved at once. Very soon after this my Aunt Jinny and Uncle Noah ran away, and the great noise made about it by your father-in-law, [the father-in-law of the slave master] made me for the first time acquainted with the fact, that there were free States as well as slave States. From that time, I resolved that I would someday run away. The morality of the act, I dispose as follows: I am myself; you are yourself; we are two distinct persons, equal persons. What you are, I am. You are a man, and so am I. God created both, and made us separate beings. I am not by nature bound to you, or you to me. Nature does not make your existence depend upon me, or mine to depend upon yours. I cannot walk upon your legs, or you upon mine. I cannot breathe for you, or you for me; I must breathe for myself, and you for yourself. We are distinct persons, and are each equally provided with faculties necessary to our individual existence. In leaving you, I took nothing but what belonged to me, and in no way lessened your means for obtaining an honest living. Your faculties remained yours, and mine became useful to their rightful owner.”Liberty is a gift of God inbred in human nature and is fully understood only when it is claimed as a personal possession. It is this claim of liberty that shatters forever the chains that tie a man to slavery. The will to freedom and independence is irrepressible and stronger than the will to power.During his own day, Douglass was the freest man alive in a nation that held men, women and children as slaves. He escaped his slave master and headed north.
Working on the wharves of New Bedford, Massachusetts, Douglass earned his first honest dollar, a liberating experience: “It was there I earned my first free dollar. It was mine. I could spend it as I pleased. I could buy hams or herring with it, without asking any odds of any body. That was a precious dollar to me.” Marriage was liberating: “I soon, however, learned to count money, as well as to make it, and got on swimmingly. I married soon after leaving you: in fact, I was engaged to be married before I left you; and instead of finding my companion a burden, she was truly a helpmeet. She went to live at service, and I to work on the wharf, and though we toiled hard the first winter, we never lived more happily.” By chance -- or more likely, Douglass thought, by the hand of God -- he met “Wm. Lloyd Garrison, a person of whom you have possibly heard, as he is pretty generally known among slaveholders. He put it into my head that I might make myself serviceable to the cause of the slave by devoting a portion of my time to telling my own sorrows, and those of other slaves which had come under my observation. This was the commencement of a higher state of existence than any to which I had ever aspired.”
Through such winding pathways, he was introduced to an excellent society of like liberty-loving souls, among whom were notable northern abolitionists – such as Henry David Thoreau, the author of “Slavery in Massachusetts”, Julia Ward Howe, who authored “The Battle Hymn of the Republic,” sung to the tune of an older freedom hymn, “[John Brown’s Body](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=7de0ad1aa5&e=8763c56857),” a marching song of northern Civil War troops – and, much later, Abraham Lincoln, the Great Emancipator.
He also met and had some business with John Brown, like him a free man. When he moved from Connecticut to Ohio, Brown astonished his neighbors by giving a pew he had purchased to a black family. In his “[A Plea for Captain John Brown](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=7c7d32c910&e=8763c56857)”, Thoreau said of Brown, “He would have left a Greek accent slanting the wrong way, and righted up a falling man.”The excellence of the society Douglass moved in “exerted a beneficial influence on my mind and heart. Much of my early dislike of white persons was removed, and their manners, habits and customs, so entirely unlike what I had been used to in the kitchen-quarters on the plantations of the South, fairly charmed me, and gave me a strong disrelish for the coarse and degrading customs of my former condition. I therefore made an effort so to improve my mind and deportment, as to be somewhat fitted to the station to which I seemed almost providentially called. The transition from degradation to respectability was indeed great, and to get from one to the other without carrying some marks of one’s former condition, is truly a difficult matter.”
On this point, Douglass is unsparing: “Oh! sir, a slaveholder never appears to me so completely an agent of hell, as when I think of and look upon my dear children. It is then that my feelings rise above my control. I meant to have said more with respect to my own prosperity and happiness, but thoughts and feelings which this recital has quickened unfits me to proceed further in that direction. The grim horrors of slavery rise in all their ghastly terror before me, the wails of millions pierce my heart, and chill my blood. I remember the chain, the gag, the bloody whip, the deathlike gloom overshadowing the broken spirit of the fettered bondman, the appalling liability of his being torn away from wife and children, and sold like a beast in the market. Say not that this is a picture of fancy. You well know that I wear stripes on my back inflicted by your direction; and that you, while we were brothers in the same church, caused this right hand, with which I am now penning this letter, to be closely tied to my left, and my person dragged at the pistol’s mouth, fifteen miles, from the Bay side to Easton to be sold like a beast in the market, for the alleged crime of intending to escape from your possession. All this and more you remember, and know to be perfectly true, not only of yourself, but of nearly all of the slaveholders around you.”
The Lincoln-Douglass connection is not often remarked upon.Lincoln’s most stirring address is not, to my way of thinking, the Gettysburg Address, but rather his Second Inaugural Address, a few lines of which are engraved on the north wall of the Lincoln Memorial. Lincoln showed his address to Douglas before he delivered it, and Douglas nodded approval of the following lines, engraved on the wall by Evelyn Beatrice Longman: “The Almighty has His own purposes. ‘Woe unto the world because of offenses; for it must needs be that offenses come, but woe to that man by whom the offense cometh.’ If we shall suppose that American slavery is one of those offenses which, in the providence of God, must needs come, but which, having continued through His appointed time, He now wills to remove, and that He gives to both North and South this terrible war as the woe due to those by whom the offense came, shall we discern therein any departure from those divine attributes which the believers in a living God always ascribe to Him? Fondly do we hope, fervently do we pray, that this mighty scourge of war may speedily pass away. Yet, if God wills that it continue until all the wealth piled by the bondsman's two hundred and fifty years of unrequited toil shall be sunk, and until every drop of blood drawn with the lash shall be paid by another drawn with the sword, as was said three thousand years ago, so still it must be said ‘the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.’”
Among the crowd present when Lincoln delivered his address was his assassin, John Wilkes Booth.
What Thoreau said of Brown – that he fronted the world without fear of men, but trembled only before a merciful and just God – is also true of Douglass, who loved, in this order, his God, his wife and children, honor and strength, and likeminded servants of light and courage. In running away from the bloody lash of his master, he came to himself at last, overmastered slavery, and met a man who loved liberty rather than servitude at the command of immoral men, honor rather than dishonor, and – though no graduate of Harvard, Thoreau’s alma mater – had wit and intelligence enough to know and follow the truth that set him free.

# Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

I meant to have said more with respect to my own prosperity and happiness, but thoughts and feelings which this recital has quickened unfits me to proceed further in that direction. The grim horrors of slavery rise in all their ghastly terror before me, the wails of millions pierce my heart, and chill my blood. I remember the chain, the gag, the bloody whip, the deathlike gloom overshadowing the broken spirit of the fettered bondman, the appalling liability of his being torn away from wife and children, and sold like a beast in the market. Say not that this is a picture of fancy. You well know that I wear stripes on my back inflicted by your direction; and that you, while we were brothers in the same church, caused this right hand, with which I am now penning this letter, to be closely tied to my left, and my person dragged at the pistol’s mouth, fifteen miles, from the Bay side to Easton to be sold like a beast in the market, for the alleged crime of intending to escape from your possession. All this and more you remember, and know to be perfectly true, not only of yourself, but of nearly all of the slaveholders around you.” The Lincoln-Douglass connection is not often remarked upon.Lincoln’s most stirring address is not, to my way of thinking, the Gettysburg Address, but rather his Second Inaugural Address, a few lines of which are engraved on the north wall of the Lincoln Memorial. Lincoln showed his address to Douglas before he delivered it, and Douglas nodded approval of the following lines, engraved on the wall by Evelyn Beatrice Longman: “The Almighty has His own purposes. ‘Woe unto the world because of offenses; for it must needs be that offenses come, but woe to that man by whom the offense cometh.’ If we shall suppose that American slavery is one of those offenses which, in the providence of God, must needs come, but which, having continued through His appointed time, He now wills to remove, and that He gives to both North and South this terrible war as the woe due to those by whom the offense came, shall we discern therein any departure from those divine attributes which the believers in a living God always ascribe to Him? Fondly do we hope, fervently do we pray, that this mighty scourge of war may speedily pass away. Yet, if God wills that it continue until all the wealth piled by the bondsman's two hundred and fifty years of unrequited toil shall be sunk, and until every drop of blood drawn with the lash shall be paid by another drawn with the sword, as was said three thousand years ago, so still it must be said ‘the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.’” Among the crowd present when Lincoln delivered his address was his assassin, John Wilkes Booth. What Thoreau said of Brown – that he fronted the world without fear of men, but trembled only before a merciful and just God – is also true of Douglass, who loved, in this order, his God, his wife and children, honor and strength, and likeminded servants of light and courage. In running away from the bloody lash of his master, he came to himself at last, overmastered slavery, and met a man who loved liberty rather than servitude at the command of immoral men, honor rather than dishonor, and – though no graduate of Harvard, Thoreau’s alma mater – had wit and intelligence enough to know and follow the truth that set him free. | Come Celebrate Frederick Douglass’s Legacy with us on June 5th | | | Why Frederick Douglass? | A Force for Uniting the United States: Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War. Believed in American Principles: History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds. A Symbol of Republican Values: Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country. Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party: The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign. | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Dominic For CT. Peter,

In 2017, I left my practice as a pediatrician to run for Congress and advocate for the hard-working families of Washington's 8th District.

While so much has changed these past few years, your support has remained constant. And for that, I'll always be eternally grateful. Thanks to your support, we've been able to accomplish so much for working families in just the past six years alone—but the truth is there's still so much work ahead.

And with this election set to determine the fate of our nation, there's too much at stake to leave things to chance. When it comes to protecting abortion rights, access to affordable healthcare, taking on the climate crisis, fixing our immigration system, and creating an economy - with childcare - that works for everyone, I need you by my side to succeed.

name: Col. Mike Waltz (Ret.)
subject: What are your core values?
body:
It’s a question that every person should ask themselves. | | | _**What are your core values?**_ It’s a question that every person should ask themselves.

In Congress, too many politicians are driven by greed and power.

_But that will never be me._

I served our country as a Green Beret, and _the same values I held every day fighting for our freedom abroad I still hold in Washington D.C. every day._

I’m going tell your about which values are most important to me, and I hope you’ll take a moment to reflect on the values YOU bring to the ballot box when you vote.

**So, let’s start with one of the most important virtues you need in leadership:_sacrifice_. **

Serving as a Green Beret, I had to put my own needs and impulses to the side for the good of our country.

I spent many birthdays, holidays, and celebrations away from my family on the other side of the world.

_It was tough, but I wouldn’t trade it for anything._

Too many politicians today have never sacrificed anything.

They’re motivated by self interest, not the interests of our country.

**Let me be clear: I will always put service to my country and my constituents over my own personal gain.**

**[I’m on a mission to bring more leaders to Washington who put service over self, but I need your help. Can you pitch in now and help us win for real leaders?](http://links.mwaltzforcongress.com/u/click?_t=d89142ed55974e2696402eb6b29e4daf&_m=9540d1e1331b4779b14c43359fabd4aa&_e=7ul66VP4Wrbnlj0bJcFZ6G7Ary0eALohh6NzuVxrjUBFTOj4smXRIyQcT8je0xGfL-_cECx8EXgDl92TIR1qvynqmCMpUfdCH18NT9BQNXWh6icSOUtWDAgW33O3jBR_61ogB3iOkoxXQX1VrZE0adPpIw6a9rWXUsd0JGWbQt3HWW6ass1hZlRxKNYHJAfRmOMtGpp_4a5aBR6_ujg1bswTkNxTeEzz7eJ8bddnhE5eDjt_XnQvOgjLytU3w7WcMUTWzXjOP6eNs-XkWLY2JUD_3C9yXgyAkeZ9bw_OknjxW0464CZfoNvI5oN-Ys-2EkIF4fc40Vqc8nHku_eYwd38AxyujajKWEy0GqLqy69RXoEj6DNzfRy7qJ1hLoxe)**

name: Greg Casar
subject: The freedom to protest is under assault
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GREG CASAR FOR CONGRESS
body:
Peter, before I ever ran for office, I was a labor organizer in Texas.
We helped organize working families to successfully come together to fight for better wages, better benefits, or better treatment by employers. **A critical part of those successes was utilizing our rights to protest.**
The freedom to protest is one of the pillars of our democracy – and it’s how women got the right to vote, how the Civil Rights Movement ended segregation, and how we secured the abortion rights currently under assault in this country.
But the right to protest is under assault today. States like Texas have used law enforcement to attack peaceful protesters **based on their views alone**. Gov. Greg Abbott recently pardoned a man for shooting and killing a Black Lives Matter protestor **based on the views of the victim and the accused, not based on the merits of the case**. And the Supreme Court has refused to take up a case that could leave protest leaders legally responsible for the actions of random protest attendees.
**This is an alarming assault on the First Amendment’s Freedom of Assembly. That’s why I recently spoke to the Washington Post about my experience organizing, protesting, and even purposely and peacefully being arrested while exercising these rights.**

clean_body: Peter, before I ever ran for office, I was a labor organizer in Texas. We helped organize working families to successfully come together to fight for better wages, better benefits, or better treatment by employers. A critical part of those successes was utilizing our rights to protest. The freedom to protest is one of the pillars of our democracy – and it’s how women got the right to vote, how the Civil Rights Movement ended segregation, and how we secured the abortion rights currently under assault in this country. But the right to protest is under assault today. States like Texas have used law enforcement to attack peaceful protesters based on their views alone. Gov. Greg Abbott recently pardoned a man for shooting and killing a Black Lives Matter protestor based on the views of the victim and the accused, not based on the merits of the case. And the Supreme Court has refused to take up a case that could leave protest leaders legally responsible for the actions of random protest attendees. This is an alarming assault on the First Amendment’s Freedom of Assembly. That’s why I recently spoke to the Washington Post about my experience organizing, protesting, and even purposely and peacefully being arrested while exercising these rights. = = **= Thank you, -Greg Greg Casar Congressman Texas Congressional District 35 ****=** | ****** ---|---
