| Peter,

Right now, we're seeing extremism in our politics like never before. Just this week, Trump released a video with the words “Unified Reich,” and Louisiana passed yet another draconian bill to restrict medication abortion – a prelude to the kind of legislation MAGA Republicans want to pass nationwide.

As someone who was raised by a dad who was a Democrat and my Republican grandparents, I understand the importance of finding common ground. But when our democracy itself is under attack, we must act.

I'm running for Congress to bring our communities together and strengthen our democracy, not tear us apart with divisive rhetoric and legislation. **I believe that we can achieve real results for our communities by standing strong for our values and working together.** From restoring federal protections for abortion rights to safeguarding voting rights, addressing the climate crisis, and so much more, I'm committed to leaving a better future for generations to come.

But I can't do this alone. With so much at stake in November, we need to ensure that democracy prevails. clean_body: | | | Peter, We are all heartbroken by the tragic mass shootings and everyday gun violence that plague our nation. That's why I want to personally invite you to join me in taking action to end gun violence at next month’s Rock the Ride. Peter- Mark your calendar! Saturday, June 22nd is the seventh annual Rock the Ride , a benefit ride and walk for gun violence prevention. Rock the Ride is a dedicated platform that aims to raise funds in support of local and national organizations committed to putting an end to gun violence in our country. As an avid cycler and advocate for gun violence prevention, Mike is proud to lead the ride and is hoping for the biggest turnout yet. Mike is a lifelong hunter and gun owner himself, so he knows firsthand how important it is that firearms are used responsibly. That’s why he’s introduced a bipartisan bill to expand background checks and close loopholes that might lead to devastating shootings. By Illinois Review

On Friday during the Illinois Republican Party State Convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Vince Kolber on the ballot despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws.

As part of the nomination process, candidates are required to submit before the convention their certified voting record to show that they voted in the last three Illinois Republican primaries. But Kolber, who is registered to vote as a full time resident in both Illinois and Wisconsin – only submitted information for two Illinois primaries – 2022 and 2024. The omission of where he voted in 2020 would have automatically disqualified him from running for national committeeman per the bylaws, but an exception was made and Kolber remains on the ballot.

In a vote of 14-3, Kolber was able to cheat the rules – proving that if you are a favored candidate of the party establishment – rules can be broken. Kolber faces state central committee members (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/il-gop-national-committeeman-race-heats-up-includes-a-former-state-party-chairman-and-a-wisconsin-voter.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=1241e4c6c0-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) Dean White and Mark Shaw.

By Dean White

Illinois is more than an ATM for political self-promotion for some, or a place of standing for others. It’s my home.

As an Illinoisian with deep family roots from the 1800’s, my family was in the obscure business of fences. Business was good enough, but I thought it could be something more, so I gathered good people around me to mentor me and I remained close to the customers delivering on the promise of quality and stuck with it. Thus, not so amazing, business grew and grew.

Succeeding in business like in politics requires the steadfastness of the values of hard work, personal responsibility, anchored in the deep belief of American exceptionalism and never forget who got you there. Like business customers, voters are more than our Party Pals, so I know the majority out there want something more than what they have gotten in the past.

The change voters are seeking is a leader, business smart, present, highly visible and principled, while always reaching out to listen, represent, and lift Republicans to be the choice versus the current leadership malaise of accepting the word “minority” as a permanent position.

The Republican Party exists in Illinois to win seats, win the majority, and advance a Republican, good government agenda. Anything short of that is political pandering, noise, and a loser position.

I am dedicated to the notion the voters know. They know it, sense it, feel it and are pummeled every day by the actions of our State Executive, enabled by us taking our eye off the ball hobbled as the minority, giving it all away to whatever mob shows up. This is on us, you and me.

It is time for a change for Illinois as I have gone everywhere I have been asked, and done anything requested, to stoke fires of change for Illinoisians to once again believe in the American Promise: Only in America, you can strive and be the best version of yourself.

The Republican Party is out of excuses, and it is time for change.

I am Dean White and thank you to all Republican Illinoisians who are taking their seat at the tables in all those visible and obscure, elected positions in Illinois to represent all the voters who are more than their pals, they are their community.

IL GOP Bylaws Ignored to Allow Vince Kolber to Remain a National Committeeman Candidate Despite Failing to Meet Requirements During GOP State Convention () By Illinois Review On Friday during the Illinois Republican Party State Convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Vince Kolber on the ballot despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws. As part of the nomination process, candidates are required to submit before the convention their certified voting record to show that they voted in the last three Illinois Republican primaries. But Kolber, who is registered to vote as a full time resident in both Illinois and Wisconsin – only submitted information for two Illinois primaries – 2022 and 2024. The omission of where he voted in 2020 would have automatically disqualified him from running for national committeeman per the bylaws, but an exception was made and Kolber remains on the ballot. In a vote of 14-3, Kolber was able to cheat the rules – proving that if you are a favored candidate of the party establishment – rules can be broken. Kolber faces state central committee members () Dean White and Mark Shaw. subject: The reason you get so many emails...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1464%2E135344%2EkPtri9)

Friend --
Sometimes it shocks me that anyone donates to fundraising emails from political campaigns.
If you're anything like me, you open your email in the morning and it's overflowing with emails from every Senate campaign, House campaign, the presidential campaign, party committees, and organizations you know and likely many you've never heard of. Most of the time I haven’t signed up for these lists.
I get why these emails happen: they are an increasingly important part of how campaigns and organizations are funded. Especially on the Democratic side. Our small dollar, online, and texting programs are light-years more productive than the GOP, and often account for a third of our monthly fundraising.
So in a sea of Democratic emails and texts, I do my best to differentiate our content, and edit every single one, including this one. The fact that you opened this email instead of deleting it and made it this far gives me hope there's a chance.
There is no winning the Senate without this race in Michigan. There is no winning the White House either. At the same time, this is going to be one of the most competitive (and expensive) races in the country. Poll after poll shows it razor tight.
Republicans know that too, that is why they'll put ridiculous amounts of money in to beat us. And since I don’t accept corporate PAC money, I have to rely on the generosity of individuals like you who understand the stakes of this race.
Hopefully that's a compelling case. It’s my job to make it. Because there's no winning this race without a significant response to emails like this by people like you.
[**Would you consider contributing $3 to my Senate campaign in Michigan to help me hold this seat, and the Senate, for Democrats in November? name: Wesley Bell
subject: I’ve been reflecting on this campaign recently
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
Peter – our primary is less than four months away, and right now, my priority is meeting as many voters across the district as possible.

I’ve been spending a lot of time the last week reflecting on this campaign and what lies ahead. Whether you’ve volunteered for this campaign, hosted or attended an event, or donated to this movement, I wanted to take a moment to say: Thank you. Fair, efficient, and simple are words you probably don't associate with our tax system. But what if they could be?

Unfortunately, the federal income tax is a complete mess.

It's not efficient, fair, or simple. It fosters tax avoidance and cheating and costs billions of dollars to administer. First proposed in 1981 by Hoover fellows Alvin Rabushka and Robert Hall, the flat tax was intended to simplify the federal tax system by replacing the progressive federal income tax system with a low and simple flat tax. They believed that the flat tax was the fairest, most efficient, simplest, and most workable tax plan.

The flat tax plan would give an enormous boost to the US economy by dramatically improving incentives to work, save, invest, and take entrepreneurial risks. It would also save taxpayers hundreds of billions in direct and indirect costs.

As we navigate the complexities of our present tax system, it becomes evident that change is necessary. The classic book, _The Flat Tax_ , critiques the flaws in our highly progressive tax structure and introduces a practical, efficient, and workable alternative.

Hall and Rabushka explain that:
* All income should be taxed once, and only once, at a uniform low rate.
* A flat tax would eliminate the distortions of the present tax treatment of business.
* It is not an academic abstraction but a workable solution that has been implemented in many countries.
* If meaningful, systematic tax reform is to succeed, it won't be birthed in Washington. It will come from millions of taxpayers demanding fairness in taxation.

That's why we want to share this Hoover Classic with as many Americans as possible, starting with you. By requesting your free copy of _The Flat Tax_ eBook, you not only gain access to invaluable insights but also become part of a community engaged in reshaping our thinking on taxation.

As you delve into the pages of _The Flat Tax_ , you'll discover not only the critique of the current system but a practical alternative that has been a guiding light for those seeking fairness, efficiency, and practicality.

Join us in unlocking the legacy of _The Flat Tax_. Claim your free copy now and become part of a movement for transformative ideas in tax reform. ...serve on the January 6 Committee...

Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from my
friend Debbie Mucarsel-Powell. Debbie is running for the U.S. Senate in
Florida and she's counting on our support, so I hope you'll read her
message and [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240524_PM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=2680%2E35263%2EbRaNqn ]chip in, if you can.

Peter — when I saw this news, I was sick to my stomach:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240524_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=2680%2E35263%2EbRaNqn ]Tweet from Rick Scott announcing his bid for Senate Republican leader

This means my race to retire Rick Scott could decide BOTH the Senate
majority and the majority leader.

If we thought the current GOP Senate leadership was bad, we really don't
want the guy whose agenda was too extreme for Mitch McConnell to take his
place. He already laid out his plan for the country:

❌Pass a national abortion ban
❌End Medicare and Social Security
❌Raise taxes on the middle class

Now more than ever, it is vital that we kick him to the curb this
November.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-dmp.NuRc6p&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240524_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=2680%2E35263%2EbRaNqn ]So please, Peter, we need to raise $250,000 by midnight to
make sure this nightmare won't come true. I'm counting on you to do your
part before 11:59 p.m. and split $10 or anything you can between Tammy
Baldwin and my campaign to help me flip Florida blue, defend our
Democratic majority, and block a Rick Scott-led Senate.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-dmp.RYg70l&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240524_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=2680%2E35263%2EbRaNqn ]DONATE

Make no mistake: Mitch McConnell's time as Senate GOP leader was one of
the worst things to ever happen to the Senate. It will take years for our
country and our democracy to fully recover from his decades of corruption,
cronyism, extremism, and obstruction.

But Rick Scott as Senate GOP leader would be much, much worse.

He oversaw one of the biggest Medicare frauds in U.S. history and used the
money to buy his seat. Then he wrote the plan to raise taxes on working
families and end Medicare and Social Security. THEN, he co-sponsored a
nationwide ban on abortions that could send doctors to prison. All that
destruction and he's only been in the Senate for a single term. Imagine
what he could do as GOP Leader.

In short — Rick Scott shouldn't be allowed to step foot in the U.S.
Senate, let alone lead the GOP caucus, whether they have the majority or
not.

But with McConnell out of the way, Scott is under the impression that this
will be an easy win. I need your help to prove him wrong.

This is a make-or-break moment, not just for my campaign but for our
entire country. [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2533?c0=tbe-em-dmp.NuRc6p&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240524_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=2680%2E35263%2EbRaNqn ]My team set a $250,000 emergency fundraising goal to
make sure we never see a Rick Scott-led Senate, and it will take each and
every one of us doing our part to hit it. I'm hoping I can count on you to
split just $10 between Tammy Baldwin and my campaign to make sure we don't
fall short so we can defeat Rick Scott.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and Tammy Baldwin will go through
immediately:

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2151?c0=tbe-em-dmp.yOrXNk&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20240524_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=2680%2E35263%2EbRaNqn ]SPLIT $10 NOW

Hi there, Monday is Memorial Day where we come together to honor the courageous men and women who have made the ultimate sacrifice in service to our great nation. Our fallen heroes serve as a poignant reminder of the extraordinary price of freedom and the enduring strength of the American spirit. As your future congresswoman, I am committed to helping build a nation worthy of their sacrifice. We need leadership that puts the interests of the American people first, and I am ready to roll up my sleeves and get to work. Together, we can ensure the freedoms and opportunities our fallen heroes fought for remain accessible to all. Thank you for your continued support, and God Bless America. Warm regards,

** **✅ Speaker of the House Mike Johnson** **✅ House Republican Conference Chair Elise Stefanik** **✅ House Majority Leader Steve Scalise** **✅ House Majority Whip Tom Emmer** **✅ Winning for Women PAC** **✅ Congresswoman Harriet Hageman** _(new!)_ **✅ E-PAC** _(new!)_ **✅ Value In Electing Women (VIEW) PAC** _(new!)_

---
**Officially Filed To Run For Congress**
---
This week I officially filed to unseat Mary Peltola in Congress, because Alaska needs strong, proven, conservative leadership. Mary Peltola's track record shows she does not have our state's interests at heart. Her reckless energy policies are harming our economy; her anti-military votes undermine our security, and her stance on open borders threatens our safety. Alaskans are fed up with Peltola's failed leadership, and I am the best candidate to bring real conservative representation to Congress.
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=f51be4e318&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
|
---
**My Visit To The Southern Border** Last week, I traveled to the southern border in Arizona and saw the dire consequences of Joe Biden's failed policies. As your Congresswoman, I will work to ensure that our border is closed and secure. Check out my interview on the Mike Porcaro show _[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=213057d20d&e=a20d8ad2ed)__here_ , where I discussed my trip to the Southern Border.
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=42641aaa1c&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
I was shocked and appalled by what I saw on my visit. President Trump's wall project is incomplete, with unused materials languishing in the sun and illegal migrants pouring in. Local law enforcement I spoke with confirmed that the situation at the border is worse than ever.
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=5f46862806&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
The influx of fentanyl into Alaska is a direct outcome of our failed border policies, harming our families and communities. Mary Peltola and Joe Biden have allowed this situation to unfold on their watch. It's clearer than ever that America cannot afford another four years of Joe Biden. It's time to stop the political games and secure our border. _**Watch a video from my visit below. **_
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=4896034f7d&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
---
|
---
**Fairbanks Meet & Greet** It was great meeting with fellow Republicans in Fairbanks this week. I enjoyed talking about our plan to take back this seat. It’s clear we have a significant amount of work ahead. Joe Biden's reckless border, energy, and economic policies are severely hurting Alaskans. I look forward to flipping #AKAL and electing President Trump this November to steer our country back on the right course.
---
[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=eba082e729&e=a20d8ad2ed)
---
| | **Rep. Harriet Hageman Endorses Nancy Dahlstrom** In case you missed it, Congresswoman Harriet Hageman (R-Wyo.) endorsed my campaign for Congress late last week. Rep. Hageman’s endorsement comes on the heels of other prominent GOP female leaders’ support, including House Republican Conference Chairwoman Elise Stefanik and her PAC, E-PAC.
---
|
---
"Of _all places, Alaska must be represented by solid conservatives, and so I strongly support Nancy Dahlstrom for Congress. As Lt. Gov., she has fought to protect Alaska from Washington, DC, and in Congress, she will fight to unleash Alaska's limitless energy potential."_ _- _**Harriet Hageman, United States Representative**

Let's retire Mary Peltola. Week after week, month after month, Mary Peltola is abandoning Alaskan values to appease Joe Biden and the radical left. Thankfully, the dedicated volunteers at the Alaska GOP are keeping track of her destructive behavior. At the end of last week, the House passed legislation that would require the Census Bureau to include a citizenship question on all future censuses and exclude non-citizens from any headcount used to determine population for representation in Congress and electoral votes. To no surprise, Congresswoman Mary Peltola **_opposed the bill_** and **voted to allow the census to continue counting noncitizens.** As the border crisis continues to worsen under Joe Biden and Washington Democrats, Peltola’s latest vote raised some eyebrows. _**[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=6b73b1f3fe&e=a20d8ad2ed)**__**If you haven't seen it yet, follow the link below to check out the Peltola files and stay up to date on the fight to restore conservative values to Alaska's congressional seat.**_

| | This is my favorite story to tell, Peter. It's about my grandmother... I'm running for Congress because I'm dedicated to helping our grandchildren achieve their dreams here in Alaska, one of the greatest places on earth. **_The Alaska dream _IS_ the American dream._** My grandmother emigrated to America to pursue a better life. She came through Ellis Island knowing no English. But she met my grandfather, and together, they educated themselves and harnessed the opportunities that built the American dream for our family. _**That can-do American spirit is under assault by a federal government that disincentivizes entrepreneurship and encourages laziness. **_ I've dedicated my public service to preserving the dream for my grandchildren and yours. But I'm also on this mission in honor of my grandmother and the opportunities she seized for us. _**[_**Click here to learn more about my plan to preserve Alaska's promise and the American dream for generations to come.**_](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=a8e41c2a970b44d0a291e2cbf8512a7f&_m=60fa3a56d9e0465f8486372562ab453c&_e=xzdACVIwAx2M5NMskkv4hItZCM9rp8HTsbG7oE10uTc3iH4x2JRoSMxKsQZg1Xw99ZxiJD0Dq1SfpXJGfO7V3Gj22SF7m_GUmxko-qloakMScwvXCd33SZ6igGcq5ffxUoVkwXkvNfeNVybbF3kgbBinC_9hz4HhNHS8kM5yfRDiAnQZgcALiDNSBHFkQRCOgpdR7QIheckthfX2SrGMPfAZB0E6nqdKfyqseuN-Mc4hseDvqd9JYbVMfYvBcm7hk3y9Tra2_8lkVzXvqfi0zXHFVcKVBiYN_JEbM9ls2bwPKi1e40dvRaMe6D6Rcrj0)**_ Warm regards,**Nancy Dahlstrom** _Candidate for Congress | Alaska At-Large_

body:
| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85583352/475236763/-734826637?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ1ZTEyODY1LTIxMWEtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XOL6DmwVTYJo8OpQJ1E6uQuinpq6HPSZ13Xmga0ZGRM=&emci=6a401388-0c1a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=45e12865-211a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, Do you want **safer, more environmentally sustainable, financially stable, and well-maintained transportation choices for all Oregonians?** Join our Transportation Campaign Briefing with community organizations from throughout Oregon! OLCV is working with active transportation, climate, and environmental justice groups to pass forward-thinking legislation in 2025 to benefit every Oregonian in urban and rural communities. The Oregon Joint Committee on Transportation announced a 2024 listening tour to gather input on how to fund and invest in transportation in 2025. **Each stop on the listening tour will include a public hearing, which you can participate in - and we’re here to help you prepare!**
* Downtown Portland
* Group 1 – First Stop
* Tuesday, June 4
* Tillamook
* Group 2
* Tuesday, June 18
* Albany
* Group 3

* Eugene

* During the September legislative days meeting at the Capitol
* Wednesday, September 25
* Happy Valley
* Group 1 - Last Stops

* Hillsboro
* Group 1 - Last Stops

We’ll be hosting virtual and in-person briefings around the state to help you and your community prepare to make your voices heard at each one of these stops. The tour’s first stop will be in Portland at PCC Cascades (705 N Killingsworth St) on June 4th at 5 PM, so we’re kicking off the summer with a briefing to help our Portland-area partners get ready: **[Register for our Transportation Campaign Briefing on May 28th, 6pm-7pm on Zoom!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85583354/475236765/-1393166594?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ1ZTEyODY1LTIxMWEtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XOL6DmwVTYJo8OpQJ1E6uQuinpq6HPSZ13Xmga0ZGRM=&emci=6a401388-0c1a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=45e12865-211a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)** This briefing is for anyone interested in writing or giving testimony at the Downtown Portland listening tour stop on June 4th; if you’re not in Portland, you’re still invited to learn more about the legislative path to safe, clean, fair, and accountable transportation. We’ll share:
* What’s at stake in the 2025 session
* Key messages or stories to share with legislators
* How you can make your voice heard in the listening tour and beyond!

[**Register in advance for this meeting here.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85583356/475236769/-1393166594?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ1ZTEyODY1LTIxMWEtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XOL6DmwVTYJo8OpQJ1E6uQuinpq6HPSZ13Xmga0ZGRM=&emci=6a401388-0c1a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=45e12865-211a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) After registering, you will receive a confirmation email containing information about joining the meeting. Please email [cassie@friends.org](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85583357/475236772/-114723911?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQ1ZTEyODY1LTIxMWEtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XOL6DmwVTYJo8OpQJ1E6uQuinpq6HPSZ13Xmga0ZGRM=&emci=6a401388-0c1a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=45e12865-211a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) with any questions. name: Rick Scott
subject: My life through pictures.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rick Scott for Florida
body:
It’s important to me that you know my story so I can set the record straight.| | | Peter, serving this country has been the greatest honor of my life.

Over the years, liberals have tried to lie about me and ruin our hard work to rescue America.
It’s important to me that you know my story, Peter.

I was born poor and lived in public housing. My adoptive father was a World War II Veteran and truck driver, and my mother worked multiple jobs to provide a roof over our heads and put food on the table.

---
[](http://links.voterickscott.com/u/click?_t=24d1692d4ad14657a18af9ad6ea13243&_m=c336af488af3421a93023db53d9e7b25&_e=e8ymM6xKzefGt2X-hro2CFc74LO-xDNfJ1nzkFWjKVd7tpZ0hoNL8RFLg8o_KliKT7Uxm_QKbT7BS17Qs81kOhqGQ3Q5XwFBILSEIy1ozk8yAxyOrJ7vPXzNcTyNw1DD4dsO40XpXMwYLO7TevCowWIlYLcRzszA2a79LxwHVHG_ava3GC2gEPUtgkcJ_fKXFlXN5F2HG8nNz6irNgn5B-Na6oyd3mR-PAXQ8aGkAR5VNu1McqUZV2Y9dh7dsHA9Ut1QXlnh4tXvefQm_XLpBoQhdfmvxgmiutuMrm_2DuRUpXz173kqdKxXsmlK15hDMJ0M0S9TF61MDpkKCf1UFopHGpiuZ0QzY29tmrRol2zmmG3RWrNY6ZK6lo7mM7BA)
---
**_Life was hard._**

I married my high school sweetheart, Ann, and then joined the Navy as a radar man aboard the USS Glover.
---
[](http://links.voterickscott.com/u/click?_t=24d1692d4ad14657a18af9ad6ea13243&_m=c336af488af3421a93023db53d9e7b25&_e=e8ymM6xKzefGt2X-hro2CFc74LO-xDNfJ1nzkFWjKVd7tpZ0hoNL8RFLg8o_KliKT7Uxm_QKbT7BS17Qs81kOhqGQ3Q5XwFBILSEIy1ozk8yAxyOrJ7vPXzNcTyNw1DD4dsO40XpXMwYLO7TevCowWIlYLcRzszA2a79LxwHVHG_ava3GC2gEPUtgkcJ_fKXFlXN5F2HG8nNz6irNgn5B36kxeZ3Hl_zfyEQ4UK8rFJMwO9ql5giMMIWMOESe15RF_xmirvrLKHHB7AbzjYW8EZYSp2pHU-qfI3Eurj1PPNe639zjWYuDGcDctovHqmdFumiFkiyxsPk8JATPGlTJYTI1z9hSstf8X8cMG5UO_Hhj4h9QByTsQaiFpfV_t-j)
---

body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3068%2E552475%2E3xx_R3)
Hi Peter, it’s Bob.
I always enjoy visiting our campaign headquarters... especially because my team put up a mini basketball hoop outside our conference room.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240524-3?refcode=em20240524-3&refcode2=3068_552475_3xx_R3&akid=3068%2E552475%2E3xx_R3) **[Click here to see if I made the shot.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240524-3?refcode=em20240524-3&refcode2=3068_552475_3xx_R3&akid=3068%2E552475%2E3xx_R3)**
In case you didn’t know, I played some hoops back in the day. From coaching my daughter’s basketball games to getting on the court with President Obama on Election Day 2008, I’d like to think I still have some game.
Regardless of whether I made the shot — _though you should_** _[click here](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240524-3?refcode=em20240524-3&refcode2=3068_552475_3xx_R3&akid=3068%2E552475%2E3xx_R3)_** _to see if I did_ — my time on the court taught me to always keep your head in the game, from tip-off to the final buzzer.
That lesson is still true today. My opponent has the backing of Mitch McConnell and Wall Street billionaires, not to mention his personal fortune. They’re already spending millions, and we need to keep our campaign going strong to take them on.
**[With you on our team, we can run the court. Every donation you make helps us put points on the board to defend our Senate majority.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240524-3?refcode=em20240524-3&refcode2=3068_552475_3xx_R3&akid=3068%2E552475%2E3xx_R3)**

With gratitude,
Bob Casey

Hi Peter, today marks the second anniversary of the devastating school shooting in Uvalde. 2 years ago today, nineteen children who should have been safe at school were killed by senseless gun violence. Our students deserve to be able to come to school and learn in classrooms without the fear of gun violence. Parents deserve to be able to drop their kids off at school or daycare without fearing for their child’s life. It is unacceptable that this isn’t the reality in Texas and the rest of this country. My faith has taught me to love my neighbor and to fight for what is right. Enough is enough. We need common-sense gun safety legislation like universal background checks and red flag laws to finally put an end to senseless gun violence. South Texans deserve a leader who will fight for our families. I’m running for Congress to defend our community and fight for gun violence prevention. I’ll never stop fighting to make our schools, places or worship, and neighborhoods safer. Enough is enough. — Michelle

body:
ICJ orders Israel ‘to immediately halt’ Rafah assault.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=icj_rafah_rr&n=1)
---
Peter – The walls are closing in on Netanyahu. Will his ‘close, personal friend’ Joe Biden continue to save him from accountability?

---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=icj_rafah_rr&n=2)
---
This week we learned the prosecutor from the International Criminal Court is seeking arrest warrants for Netanyahu and top Hamas leaders. Now we have a ruling from the International Court of Justice ordering Israel ‘to immediately halt’ their assault on Rafah.

Israel responded to this news in the manner we’ve come to expect – with defiance, denials, and deceit.

The official statement released by Israel via X/Twitter flatly denied that they are even _conducting_ military operations against civilians in Rafah and lied about keeping the Rafah passage open to allow aid in.

Everyone can see the truth of what is happening here. Some will choose to disbelieve their own eyes, and they will have to live with that choice.

**But we will NOT close our eyes to Israel’s atrocities, and we WILL NOT stop until Palestine is free.

** Ours is the ONLY campaign slated to be on the ballot across the country this November that stands unequivocally with the people of Gaza, which sees our fight for people, planet, and peace as inextricable from the fight for Palestinian liberation.

**[I need your help in this final push to get on the ballot in New York to guarantee that EVERY American will have a peace candidate to vote for in November. Will you give $25 or whatever you can spare today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=icj_rafah_rr&n=3)**

---
Benjamin Netanyahu may have a ‘close, personal friend’ in our current president – but he won’t when I am elected.

As president, the first thing I will do is end the supply of weapons and military aid to Israel, while it is in violation of international law, including its practice of genocide, ethnic cleansing, and the occupation of Gaza and the West Bank.

I will push the Senate to ratify the Rome Statute recognizing the legal authority of the International Criminal Court. And I will direct all U.S. federal agencies with the proper authority to recognize and execute any valid arrest warrant issued by the ICC over Israel’s war crimes.

I will not allow the foreign policy of the most powerful and influential nation on earth to be dictated by a despot clinging to the last threads of his power in a genocidal apartheid state.

Benjamin Netanyahu will face justice under a Jill Stein administration.

In solidarity,

Jill

But we will NOT close our eyes to Israel’s atrocities, and we WILL NOT stop until Palestine is free. Ours is the ONLY campaign slated to be on the ballot across the country this November that stands unequivocally with the people of Gaza, which sees our fight for people, planet, and peace as inextricable from the fight for Palestinian liberation. | "DONATE NOW" Benjamin Netanyahu may have a ‘close, personal friend’ in our current president – but he won’t when I am elected. As president, the first thing I will do is end the supply of weapons and military aid to Israel, while it is in violation of international law, including its practice of genocide, ethnic cleansing, and the occupation of Gaza and the West Bank. I will push the Senate to ratify the Rome Statute recognizing the legal authority of the International Criminal Court. And I will direct all U.S. federal agencies with the proper authority to recognize and execute any valid arrest warrant issued by the ICC over Israel’s war crimes. I will not allow the foreign policy of the most powerful and influential nation on earth to be dictated by a despot clinging to the last threads of his power in a genocidal apartheid state. Benjamin Netanyahu will face justice under a Jill Stein administration. In solidarity, Jill | "Support Jill Today!"
